Die Reise führt zunächst in die bezaubernden Sanddünen des Empty Quarter in den Vereinigten Arabischen Emiraten. Anschließend geht es zu futuristischen Baumhäusern in einem Wald in Dorset, bevor in Irland die Fahrt mit einem gelben U-Boot ansteht.

Bild ist Sprache: die vorherrschende Sprache unserer Welt. Bilder sind mächtig und allgegenwärtig. Wir alle sind tagtäglich einer Flut von Bildern ausgesetzt, die wir mehr oder weniger bewusst wahrnehmen. Was wir sehen, kann schockieren oder bewegen.

Eine hoch diverse Meeresfauna und bizarre Landschaften im Nordwesten Mexikos bietet der 🏌️ [Golf] Golf von Kalifornien. Auf der Festlandseite liegen die Bundesstaaten Sonora und Sinaloa. Die kleinste Perlenfarm der Welt liegt in der Bucht von Bacochibampo.

Dr. Massimo Vacchetta betreibt die einzige Igelklinik Italiens. Die Verletzungen der nachtaktiven Igel sind oft schwerwiegend. Mit Feingefühl und auch unkonventionellen Methoden werden die stacheligen Patienten oft wochenlang aufgepäppelt.

pr.d: Der Geograf und Ernährungswissenschaftler Pierre Raffard reist um die Welt, um die Küchen verschiedenster Länder kennenzulernen. Dabei erfährt er, wie sie Einflüsse aus anderen Regionen der Erde in ihre eigene Kulinarik einfließen lassen.
(1): Miss Island, eine wortgewandte Schönheit (2): Marseille: eine Stadt, eine Sprache (3): Albanien: Meritas Forelle mit Gemüse (4): Italien: ein umstrittener Kongress.
Die Sendung zeigt Orte, die sich durch ihr kulturelles oder landschaftliches Erbe auszeichnen.

San José del Cabo, Cabo Pulmo und La Paz stehen im Mittelpunkt der Reise zu den Meeresbewohnern und zu den Menschen, die an der Küste leben. Der Film zeigt die Bemühungen der örtlichen Gemeinschaft, diesen Lebensraum zu erhalten und zu schützen.

Die Welt des Golfs von Kalifornien ist faszinierend und kontrastreich. Im Meer, vor der Ostküste der Halbinsel Baja California, sind viele Tierarten stark bedroht. Die Hoffnung auf das Überleben hängt dort an wenigen Menschen.

Am nördlichsten Punkt des Golfs mündet der berühmte Colorado River in das Aquarium der Welt. Das Mündungsdelta gilt als die Wiege des Golfes und grenzt an die Sonora-Wüste, eine der größten und artenreichsten Wüstenregionen der Welt.

Marina ist schön und verführerisch. Mit 14 Jahren wird sie von den Eltern allein gelassen. Ihr Halbbruder nimmt sich seine Schwester zur bezahlten Geliebten. Das ist der Anfang ihrer Karriere als Prostituierte. Marina gefällt das luxuriöse Leben - bis sie den Maler Alexander kennenlernt. Zum ersten Mal erfährt sie die wahre Liebe. Doch Alexander droht zu erblinden. Nur eine teure Operation kann ihn retten. Marina steht vor einer schweren Entscheidung.

Als im Schlosspark die Leiche einer Frau aufgefunden wird, deutet alles auf ein Sexualverbrechen hin. Doch weitere ähnliche Morde erschüttern Mönchengladbach, und die intensiven Ermittlungen des Sonderermittlungsteams "Soko Park" führen in eine Sackgasse. Zwischen falschen Spuren und rätselhaften DNA-Funden muss Kommissar Ingo Thiel einen Täter stoppen, der der Polizei stets einen Schritt voraus zu sein scheint.

Rabia, eine 19-jährige Französin, reist nach Syrien, um sich dem Dschihad anzuschließen. Unerwartet findet sie sich in einem Daesh-Frauenhaus wieder. Um zu überleben, wird sie zur Assistentin der Direktorin. Zwischen den beiden Frauen entwickelt sich eine komplexe Master-Slave-Beziehung. Rabia sieht sich gezwungen, viele ihrer Grenzen und Prinzipien zu überschreiten. Trotz der extremen Umstände und moralischen Konflikte passt sie sich an, um in dieser gefährlichen Umgebung zu bestehen.

Während des Vormarsches von Hitlers Truppen nach Westen werden im Mai 1940 etwa 400.000 alliierte Soldaten in dem nordfranzösischen Küstenort Dünkirchen eingeschlossen. Ihre Lage, eingekesselt zwischen der Nordsee und dem Feind, scheint aussichtslos. Doch in Großbritannien ersinnt man einen tollkühnen Rettungsplan: Unterstützt von Bodentruppen und Piloten der RAF sollen die Eingeschlossenen mit zahllosen kleinen Schiffen und Booten übers Wasser evakuiert werden.

pr.t: The Great British Bake Off: Second Helpings
pr.d: Not ready to hang up the apron just yet? Fear not; Jon Richardson and Judi Love welcome judges Nigella Lawson and Paul Hollywood, comedian Roisin Conaty and all of the bakers to the very last bite of this year's `Bake Off'.

After surviving a motorcycle accident, a former boxer and longtime agnostic starts to wonder if he can use his second chance to help others, leading to the surprising realisation that he's meant to be a Catholic priest.
Eyewitnesses share their stories of survival and heroism in the face of hate when, on 14 December 2025, Jewish families were targeted and attacked on Australia's famous beach.

pr.t: Kirstie and Phil's Love It or List It

Ben Hillman helps newly-weds Des and Julie find their dream home in the town of Oliva in the Spanish region of Valencia. With a budget of £105,000, they're looking to buy their first property together.
Rebecca's dreams to move up the corporate ladder are once again quashed, so she jumps at the opportunity to use her entrepreneurial management skills when Norm starts up a painting business.

The IPS strike is in its third week, and both Doug and Deacon are spending the majority of their days doing very little outside of sleeping. Can Carrie and Kelly get them out of their rut?
After a great Thanksgiving, Doug and Carrie try to recall their first Thanksgiving together and who said, 'I Love You' first. When they can't agree they decide to consult Arthur.
Doug and Carrie watch Deacon and Kelly's kids while they are out of town. When one of the kids sees them making love, they must keep him from telling his parents.
Ray's parents finally go too far, prompting him to lose his cool and kick them out of the house once and for all.

Torn between his girlfriend Amy, ex-wife Joanne and Italian bombshell Stefania, Robert foolishly decides to tell Amy he met up with Joanne. Amy runs for support from Debra, who accidentally tells her about Stefania.
Ray kills Ally's pet hamster by accident, so Debra organises a funeral. Things get emotional when Ray realises how much Ally has grown.
Frasier throws a Halloween party and invites everyone to dress as their favourite hero, and Niles shows up dressed as Martin.
Frasier accidentally destroys Martin's most cherished object, and Niles tries to teach Roz and Daphne how to play the piano.
Frasier savours his 2,000th radio broadcast, until he learns he's missing one tape from all his programmes, and has to track down an obsessed fan to complete his collection.
Frasier and Niles conspire when they find out that Kirby's girlfriend is related to a reclusive wine collector who possesses famous vintages.

Channel 4's midday news summary.

Payment day brings with it a chance to debate that most sacrilegious of all B&B faux pas: a short and curly in the bedsheets.

Laura Hamilton helps Mark and Carrie chase their Cretan dream in Rethymno. She shows them what their maximum budget of £130k can buy, from an enchanting characterful house to a quirky cottage in a sublime setting.

pr.d: Rachel makes the mistake of going for a job interview at a restaurant where her current boss is also dining. pr.sub: The One With Rachel's Going Away Party

pr.d: The six friends prepare to part ways and set out on the next chapters of their lives, with momentous events and surprises in store.

pr.sub: The One With Ross's New Girlfriend

Monica gets promoted and invites the friends out for dinner to celebrate, but problems arise when the difference in their salaries becomes apparent and the group splits in two. Es ist kaum zu glauben und scheint doch wahr zu sein. Jemand hat in Hotdoghausen ein echtes Einhorn gesichtet. Alle sind außer sich und wollen natürlich selbst einen Blick auf das außergewöhnliche Geschöpf werfen. Doch das scheint scheu zu sein.
Die Hauntleys werden darum gebeten, auf dem Batwalk in Medusas Modenschau zu laufen.

Professor von Quac hat einen Roboterhund namens Spots. Micky, Pluto und die Freunde helfen Spots zu lernen, wie man ein echter Hund ist und wie man mit allen Spaß haben kann. Vielleicht kann er dann ja mit Pluto spielen!

Dad hat sich einfach auf ein Ende der Wippe gesetzt. Deswegen treiben Bluey und Bingo den gesamten Spielplatz zusammen, um zu helfen, Dad aus dem Weg zu räumen. Doch damit es klappt, müssen sie noch einen weiteren Freund finden.

Bluey geht zum ersten Mal in ihrem Leben ins Kino. Doch sie hat Angst, denn der Film könnte zu gruselig für sie sein. Bluey muss ihren ganzen Mut beweisen und schließlich auch noch Papa helfen, als Bingo im Theater Amok läuft.
Opa soll sich ausruhen, doch Bluey und Bingo besuchen ihn und sie begeben sich auf ein Abenteuer.

Als Muffins Vater ihr sagt, dass sie etwas Besonderes sei, benutzt sie dies als Ausrede, um zu tun, was sie will. Muffins Meinung nach kann sie nun zum Beispiel Blueys und Bingos Bibliotheksspiel auf jede Art spielen, die ihr gefällt.

Das Spidey-Team muss Tante May retten, als ein neues Gerät des Grünen Kobolds die Leute glauben lässt, sie seien Piraten und sie auf Beutefang schickt. Doc Ock schiebt dem Spidey-Team eine böse Doppelgänger-Version des Spidey-Bots Trace-E unter.
pr.sub: Plündernde Piraten am Pier / Böser Bot

Haley überdenkt ihre Karriere und die Zukunft mit Dylan. Dabei braucht sie dringend Claires mütterlichen Rat. Ihr rüder Trainingsstil bringt Jay und Cam währenddessen eine wichtige Lektion in Sensibilität von Manny und Phil ein.

Die hübsche erfolgreiche Anwältin Barbara trifft in einem Restaurant auf Greg und Dharma. Sie ist überrascht, da Greg nie heiraten wollte. Dharma wird eifersüchtig, als sie erfährt, dass Greg mit Barbara zusammenarbeiten soll.

Dharmas Vater ist nach einem Schnellkurs versessen darauf, viel Geld zu verdienen. Er will, dass Dharma Yoga-Unterricht erteilt und die Videokassette mithilfe von Gregs Vater Ed vermarkten. Greg lernt, wie man sich richtig entspannt.

Dharma trifft einen Indianer auf dem Dach ihres Hauses und lädt ihn dazu ein, seine letzten Tage in ihrer Wohnung zu verbringen, da das Gebäude auf einem ehemaligen Indianerfriedhof steht. Als Greg davon erfährt, ist er außer sich vor Wut.
Jess und Ian gehen auf ihr drittes gemeinsames Date. Laut Ian bedeutet das Sex. Doch Jess will Ian nicht mit zu sich nehmen, da sie immer noch mit ihrem Ex-Mann zusammen wohnt.
Jess freut sich gar nicht auf die kommende Lehrerkonferenz. Ihr neuer Kollege, den sie richtig attraktiv findet, wird auch dabei sein. Doch sie hat sich fest vorgenommen, nichts mit ihm anzufangen.

Zwei Männer entführen Taffy, weil sie ihn für eine Rassekatze halten und wollen Lösegeld. Bentley bekommt dies mit und will dies für sich behalten, da er nun die Hoffnung hegt, dass Mrs. Münzberg ihre ganze Aufmerksamkeit ihm widmet.

Im Kampf gegen streunende Hunde setzt die Stadt die Hundefängerin Gerda ein, die gnadenlos ist. Da sie die zugleich auch äußerst furchterregend ist, könnte Bentley gefangen werden, sollte er jemals das Grundstück von Mrs. Münzberg allein verlassen.

Taffy verletzt sich mit beiden Beinen bei einem akrobatischen Kunststück und trägt nun Gips. Doch darf Bentley ausgerechnet dies nicht mitbekommen, denn sonst befürchtet Taffy, dass er seine Schleife für immer loswerden wird.
Beni stellt sich einer neuen Herausforderung und soll einen echten Weltrekord brechen.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Als Max wegen Marinette von einem Videospiel-Wettbewerb ausgeschlossen wird, wird Max zum Bösewicht namens Gamer. Er steuert einen Roboter, der Paris in Chaos versetzt. Ladybug und Cat Noir müssen ihn aufhalten, da es sonst "Game Over" heißt.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Es ist wieder Zeit für das alljährliche Klassenfoto und Julekas Pechsträhne setzt sich fort. Weil Chloé unbedingt ihren Platz einnehmen will, sorgt sie dafür, dass Juleka es nicht auf das Bild schafft. Hawk Moth verwandelt sie in Reflekta.
Die Lehrerin bittet Liff um Ratschläge bei der Partnersuche, ohne zu wissen, dass Liff ihre Tipps aus einer Seifenoper bezieht.
pr.sub: Freundschaft in der Zeit der Käsehöhlen/ Suppenoper

pr.d: Tilly und Gramma erkunden einen Tag lang als Touristen die Stadt. Cricket und Remy organisieren in der Zwischenzeit ein Abendessen mit ihren Familien zum gegenseitigen Kennenlernen.
pr.sub: Ein Herz für Big City; Gute Gastgeber

pr.t: Mystery Lane - Ein Fall für Clever und Bro
pr.d: Travis sucht Clever auf, um ihr seine Bedenken über das seltsame Verhalten seines Chefs mitzuteilen.
Lilo und Stitch begeben sich auf die Suche nach Experiment 513, Richter. Es kann Erdbeben verursachen und soll am Cocktail-Stand aushelfen.

Um zu verhindern, dass Love Händel von einem wichtigen Musikwettbewerb ausgeschlossen wird, reisen Phineas, Ferb und ihre Freunde in die Heimat des Klimpaloon. Sie müssen der Jury des Wettbewerbs beweisen, dass der magische Badeanzug Klimpaloon wirklich existiert. Währenddessen versucht Dr. Doofenschmirtz, seinen Bruder in ein Warzenschwein zu verwandeln, damit dieser seinen Bürgermeisterposten verliert.
Bingo gibt vor, Blueys neue Mitarbeiterin zu sein, während Dad im Garten trainiert.
Mama bringt Bluey am Strand das Stöckchenwerfen bei, während Bingo und Papa einen Vogelkopf finden.
Bluey wehrt sich dagegen, dass Papa ihr häufig sagt, wie sie sich verhalten soll.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Von Chloé gedemütigt, wird ihr persönlicher Butler von Hawk Moth akumatisiert. Als Despair Bear kann er jetzt jeden manipulieren, den er berührt und ist entschlossen, sich an Chloé zu rächen. Ladybug und Cat Noir müssen die Kontrolle behalten.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Marinette ist aufgeregt: Rockstar Jagged Stone wird in der Reality-Show "Tritt in meine Fußstapfen" auftreten, die in der Bäckerei ihrer Eltern gedreht wird. Aber nichts läuft wie geplant: Penny, die Assistentin, möchte es allen recht machen.

Tief unten in der Stille des Ozeans lebt Arielle, die Meerjungfrau. Sie ist die Tochter von Triton, dem Unterwasserkönig, aber anstatt ihren höfischen Pflichten nachzukommen, geht sie lieber zusammen mit dem kleinen Fisch Fabius auf Entdeckungsreise an die Oberfläche und sammelt Schätze von den Menschen. Arielle wünscht sich nämlich heimlich, selbst ein Mensch zu sein. Bei einem Unwetter rettet Arielle Prinz Eric das Leben und von da an ist es dann um sie geschehen.

Ladybug kommt nie zur Ruhe. Sie sieht sich gezwungen, ihre Kräfte mit Cat Noir zu vereinen, dem maskierten Rächer, der kein Blatt vor den Mund nimmt. Gemeinsam stellen sie sich Hawk Moth und seinem Team von Superschurken entgegen, die das Ziel haben, Paris zu zerstören. Was die Heldin Marinette nicht weiß, ist, dass sich hinter der Maske von Cat Noir eine Person verbirgt, die sie sehr gut kennt.
Percy, Annabeth und Grover werden von einem furchterregenden Gegner um einen Gefallen gebeten.
pr.sub: Ein Gott lädt uns zu Cheeseburgern ein

pr.d: Percy, Annabeth und Grover gelangen auf der Suche nach Antworten in ein Casino in Las Vegas.
pr.sub: Wir bringen ein Zebra nach Vegas

pr.d: Jess und Nick können trotz ihrer Trennung ihre Buchung für ein romantisches Cruise nicht mehr rückgängig machen. Sie laden ihre Freunde ein, um das Cruise ertragen zu können. Partner-Yoga und romantische Fotoshoots hängen ihnen bald zum Hals heraus.

Die WG macht sich auf zur letzten Hochzeit der Saison in der Hoffnung auf ein tolles Date. Jess muss auf der Party eine hartnäckige Konkurrentin aus dem Weg stoßen, während Nick mit dem Angebot eines Vierers schwer überfordert ist.

Auf der Suche nach einem spannenden Date meldet Jess sich bei der Dating-App "Dice" an. Nach etlichen Reinfällen und peinlichen Begegnungen scheint Jess endlich den Richtigen gefunden zu haben. Es könnte jedoch sein, dass der Schein trügt.

pr.d: The team re-investigate the murder of a popular DJ who died live on air after an arson attack at 80s music station Roxy Radio, while Lane is determined to find the still missing Jack Halford when Pullman and Standing threaten to quit rather than work with a new team member.
The team discovers that Mark Lovell has an alibi for the latest murder and the search is narrowed down to the remaining family members, who amongst them, have a plethora of secrets.

Anna Richardson leads people through the prickly business of choosing a partner naked. First into the studio is 21-year-old Dom, from Hampshire, who's been nominated for the show by his mum, in a desperate attempt to break his dismal dating record.
This week the Goggleboxers watched 'Race Across the World', 'The Apprentice', 'Ripley', 'MasterChef', 'Hunted', 'Celebrity Bridge of Lies', 'The Assembly' and BBC News (Hardest Geezer).

Gloria, Claire, Haley, Alex, Lily, Luke and Manny show support for gender equality and the women's movement in their own ways. Jay and Phil butt heads over their parking attendant, and Cam feels jealous when Pam prefers Mitchell's help with the baby.

Mitch and Jay end up at the same resort when they separately seek out a retreat from the family, Phil and Claire struggle to enjoy empty-nester life, and not knowing what to do with himself while Mitch is away, Cam drops in on Gloria.

The neighbouring construction site of a new golf course causes issues at Abbott, forcing the teachers to find creative solutions; an HR representative visits the school; following their kiss, Janine and Gregory's relationship status is revealed.
Barry thinks he wants a wild bachelor party, but when confronted with the reality, he realises Adam's idea of a low-key event is more his speed.
Barry is thrilled that his engagement to Lainey enables him to celebrate Christmas at her house. Marvin makes a big promise to Adam.
Barry and Lainey's wedding date is right around the corner and Beverly is in her element, but is the groom starting to have second thoughts?
In 2016, Ryan planned a wedding for his bride Maria in the school where they met. Now, Maria and her sister Veronica ask him some tricky questions about the big day.
Claire takes a first-class seat on a flight, leaving Phil in coach, and Gloria makes Jay teach Manny how to defend himself. Mitch, Cam and their friends throw Sal a belated baby shower.
While stuck at the airport, Claire partakes in online snooping that creates drama with the rest of the family.
A short clip from Rude Tube's incredibly naughty little sister Rude-ish Tube, featuring food and animals.
A short, cheeky clip featuring animals and food, from the always hilarious Tube that is Rude.
In Bedfordshire, Gavin and Jodie serve a romantic menu styled around their first date, and dance-loving duo Francis and Yvonne bring a taste of their international lifestyle to their menu.

Gordon heads to Norwalk, Ohio, in America's farming heartland, for the first of two visits to the Mill Street Bistro. There he encounters Joe Nagy, one of the most pretentious restaurant owners he has ever met.
In the dramatic conclusion to the Mill Street Bistro saga, Gordon's disagreement with proprietor Joe Nagy erupts into one of his most intense confrontations yet.
People are baffled by simple riddles; a woman loses her wig on an amusement park ride; people get stuck in things.
pr.sub: The Teen Commandments, Riddles, and Stuck

pr.d: Will buys a used car and promptly crashes into a law student's vehicle.
It is party time at the Banks residence, and the neighbour makes a surprise appearance. Then the family silver disappears, and Carlton and Will get on the case.

When Mr Burns gives high-tech eyeglasses to his employees to spy on them, Homer loves the enhanced reality of his new gadget until he finds out that Marge is seeing a marriage counsellor after she tries them on.
During a research trip, Lisa learns that Sideshow Bob is the chief scientist at a big chemical engineering company; Marge tries to teach a teen church group about healthy sexual practises.
pr.sub: The Man Who Grew Too Much

pr.d: Marge's nice-lady reputation is on the line when an unknown blackmailer threatens to expose the angry woman she is inside.
When Retirement Castle is closed, Marge asks Grampa and two other octogenarians to move in. Meanwhile, Nelson befriends Bart after Bart defends him.
Beverly decides the street where the family lives needs another stop sign, and Barry realises he's neglected his college applications.
Adam is terrified when he and his friends are recruited to the school baseball team. Geoff's father interferes in his relationship with Erica.

Phil believes he'll have a day of bad luck after failing to successfully complete his daily superstition; Mitch is certain that Cam is undermining him during their kitchen renovation; Jay is determined to get Gloria to admit she was in an accident.
Jay's friend Shorty visits from Costa Rica but spends more time with Gloria than Jay. Alex decides to prove to Claire that her relationship with Ben is a sexual one.

Phil and Claire start to question their enthusiasm for Halloween when no one else seems to feel the same. Mitch confronts Jay about how long the kitchen remodel is taking. Cam oversteps his boundaries as a house guest.
pr.sub: It's the Great Pumpkin, Phil Dunphy

Marge and Mr. Burns fight over a brash young football prodigy.

In Nottingham, long-time married couple Karen and Nigel kick off the competition with a Bajan themed menu inspired by Nigel's West Indian heritage. Joining them at the table are twenty-somethings Beth and Clem, and banter buddies Jo and Charlie.

In and around Nottingham, young lovebirds Gabz and Pete kick off the competition by cooking the food they fell in love eating together. They go up against Sushma and Gulab and country-dwelling partners John and Shaun.

Lee has just three weeks and £12,000 to pull off the perfect day for his bride-to-be Ellie. Lee wants a huge wedding that celebrates his dwarfism, and shows off his sense of humour. However, all Ellie wants is a low-key, elegant and intimate wedding.
All Hannah wants is a luxurious and relaxing wedding day when she looks a million dollars, but Tommy has a big romantic plan up his sleeve for his ex-water-skiing champ bride.

In Santa Ana, Dan and Laura hope for better units and better buyers. Rene tries to capitalise on warehouse sales and scoots away with a deal. Jarrod finally buys the locker he wants; Darrell reflects on what it means to buy lockers full of antiques.
Ivy brings his son to Moreno Valley, where good things always happen, and leaves with yo-yo's of an unexpected kind. Rene and Casey discover that their shoes are more 'air' and less 'Jordan'.
The CEO of Buffalo Wings & Rings, Nader Masadeh, meets a kitchen manager who rules his kitchen with an iron fist and discovers that one of his franchisees isn't respecting his employees.

Mill Street Bistro (Part 2/2): In the conclusion to the Mill Street Bistro saga, Gordon's disagreement with the proprietor erupts into one of his most intense confrontations yet.
Alfonso Ribeiro hosts as home video clips capture funny, surprising and memorable moments. This time: a woman loses her wig on a hair-raising amusement park ride.
Cased Up: When Will is involved in a car accident with Hilary's new boyfriend, Uncle Phil has to defend his underage and uninsured nephew in court.
Hi-Ho Silver: Will and Carlton suspect that their glamorous movie-star neighbour, Sonya Lamor (guest star Zsa Zsa Gabor), has stolen the Banks' heirloom silverware.
Specs and the City: Mr Burns gives his employees augmented reality glasses for Christmas so that he can spy on them, but the gift strains Homer and Marge's marriage.
The Man Who Grew Too Much: Sideshow Bob becomes chief scientist at a genetically modified food company.
P.S. I Hate You: Marge's reputation as Springfield's nicest resident is jeopardised when her secret stash of vitriolic letters is stolen during a house party.
The Winter of His Content: Marge invites Grampa and two other octogenarians to live at home with the family, but she's frustrated when Homer embraces their elderly lifestyle.
I Coulda Been a Lawyer: Beverly campaigns for a new stop sign on the street. Barry panics about his college applications, and Murray's attempt to help makes things worse.
Major League'd: Adam is terrified when he and his friends are recruited to the school baseball team. Geoff's father interferes in his relationship with Erica.
Catch of the Day: Phil is convinced he's going to have a bad luck day after failing to complete his daily superstition. Mitch is certain that Cam is undermining him.
Sex, Lies, and Kickball: Jay's best friend, Shorty, returns from Costa Rica and stays at the house so that they can reconnect. And Alex is ready to shed her good-girl image.
It's the Great Pumpkin, Phil Dunphy: Phil and Claire want to celebrate Halloween in a big way, but no one else seems to share their enthusiasm for it.
Ten Years Later: Claire is determined to make up for her less-than-joyful mood at Jay and Gloria's wedding by throwing their 10th-anniversary party.
The Longest Marge: Somehow, Marge and Mr Burns end up co-parenting the Springfield Atoms' new wayward star quarterback.
Pixelated and Afraid: Homer and Marge's romantic getaway gets all Bear Grylls when they end up stranded in a sprawling forest being stalked by a wolverine.
Boyz N the Highlands: Bart, Nelson, Dolph and secret bad boy Martin Prince go on a court-mandated wilderness trek as a punishment.
You Won't Believe What This Episode Is About - Act Three Will Shock You!: Homer goes viral after accidentally locking Santa's Little Helper in the car.
Pokey Mom: Marge notices a prison inmate's artistic talent and helps him to get a job painting a mural at the school. But he clashes with Skinner. Michael Keaton guest stars.
Brand new series - Ringworm: When it's revealed that a student has ringworm, the faculty must band together to stop it from spreading through the entire school.
Eyes on the Prize: When Will chooses Carlton as his teammate on a TV game show, Will's friends Tyriq and Jazz plan to get their revenge by arranging to be on the opposing team.
Those Were the Days: Phil and Vivian's radical activist friend's stories about the civil rights movement inspire Will to lead a student protest of his own.

Emily's David Bowie-inspired dish celebrates Britain's food heroes, and she uses Cornish duck meat from her local producer that she pairs with grilled radicchio and Malbec sauce. Meanwhile, Joe has also sourced his ingredients locally.

The chefs need to impress the esteemed judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver as well as a guest judge, one of the pop stars the banquet will celebrate. They are joined by one half of the synthpop duo The Communards, Reverend Richard Coles.

Tom "Westy" Westerland is a former National Chef of Wales and head chef of the Brasserie at Lucknam Park in Wiltshire. Cindy Challoner is the former head chef at prestigious teaching restaurant "The Classroom" in Cardiff. They face Andy Sheridan formerly of Sosban restaurant in Llanelli, returning to the competition for his second attempt at making it to the banquet.

Andy cooks venison in celebration of his favourite band, Oasis. He accompanies the loin with rhubarb and beetroot ketchup, black pudding purée, pickled beetroot and a pistachio crumb. Westy's beef dish 'The Cow Shed' is named after a former stage at the Glastonbury Festival.
The two remaining chefs from Wales must cook their four-course menus again. They must take on board their veteran's advice as they serve their tributes to Britain's music success.

The three chefs begin by cooking their starters for a surprise veteran of the competition. Chris' dish `Brixton Academy Through the Years' is his refined take on the classic lamb, post-gig junk food he ate after nights out at Brixton Academy.

Chris is cooking his interpretation of the classic beef dish Tournedos Rossini using guinea fowl. His inspiration is Proms in the Park and the British artists who mix classical and modern music styles. Alex's dish commemorates his late brother and the song by Northern Ireland artist Donna Taggart that he associates with the difficult time of his death.

The two remaining chefs from Northern Ireland recreate their four-course menu for the esteemed judges: food writer Matthew Fort, restaurateur Oliver Peyton and broadcaster and cook Andi Oliver. There is also a guest judge: rapper Loyle Carner.

The chefs battle to get their starter course to the Abbey Road banquet and don't disappoint with dishes dedicated to everything from Tom Jones to grime. The rivals are cooking to impress Matthew Fort, Oliver Peyton, and Andi Oliver.

Some of the finest chefs in the UK compete to cook a fish course worthy of serving at a banquet celebrating the brilliance of British popular music, held at Abbey Road Studios. Along with the show's panel of expert judges, the rivals need to impress guest judge Kanya King.

The eight regional champions will compete to get their main courses onto the final menu of the banquet at Abbey Road Studios. They will be cooking for the judges' food critic, Matthew Fort, cook and broadcaster Andi Oliver and restaurateur, Oliver Peyton plus guest judge, former Wham! star, Andrew Ridgeley. As ever, the judges will be looking for dishes laced with star quality and a good sprinkling of rock and roll wow factor worthy of a banquet full of the music industry's finest.

Some of the country's finest chefs compete over the final place cooking at a banquet celebrating the brilliance of British popular music, held at Abbey Road studios. Each rival will need to cook a dessert to impress a panel of expert judges, along with guest judge Peter Hook, Joy Division and New Order bassist, and pioneer of Britain's Madchester scene.

The chefs must cook in an unfamiliar kitchen and scale up their dishes to provide the highest calibre of dining for a full banquet room of diners. Their guests are celebrities and unsung heroes who have helped create British music's unparalleled global reputation.

Three of Scotland's top chefs, Jak O'Donnell, Jimmy Lee, and Graham Campbell - attempt to impress this week's veteran judge. Having missed out last year, returning finalist Jak is determined to make it to the banquet.

Scottish chefs Jak O'Donnell, Jimmy Lee and Graham Campbell fight it out for the fish course. Graham is in a confident mood but returning finalist Jak and self-taught Jimmy are pushing him hard. Will the pressure prove too much for ambitious Graham?

Scottish chefs Jak O'Donnell, Jimmy Lee and Graham Campbell are battling to plate up a perfect main course for this week's veteran chef. Self-taught Jimmy is honouring his mum with his rendition of her Chinese beef stew.

Today it's the Scottish chefs' last chance to impress, with the dessert course. Only two can cook for the judges tomorrow, and with one chef in the lead after a triumphant main, the pressures on for the other two to plate up perfection.

The two remaining Scottish chefs cook their entire menus again for the judges - Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They're joined by WI Calendar Girl Angela Baker, who will help decide which chef will go forward to the National Finals.

Three of the south-west's finest chefs, Jude Kereama, Josh Eggleton and Dominic Chapman attempt to impress a veteran judge with their starters. As the only newcomer, Jude is determined to plate up a winning dish, but he faces stiff competition.

The three south-west chefs fight it out for the fish course. Despite schoolboy errors during the starter, experienced Dominic is determined to get a high score on the course. But will newcomer Jude, a seafood master, overcome his nerves to plate up?
It's a battle for the main course as the three south-west chefs go head-to-head. Newcomer Jude is brimming with determination and confidence as the main course battle hits the kitchen.

The south-west chefs have one last chance to impress as they face the dessert course. Only two chefs can go through to cook for the judges with everything to play for, who will plate up perfection and who will be sent packing?

The two remaining south-west judges must cook their entire menus again for judges Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. Joining the judges is Radhika Bynon, a member of the Forest Gate Women's Institute, a modern urban group of women.

Stephen Gomes, Adam Bannister and Phil Carmichael are challenged to plate up perfect starter courses for this week's veteran judge. It's the first time in the Great British Menu kitchen for all three chefs, so who will triumph and who will fall?

Stephen Gomes, Adam Bannister and Phil Carmichael fight it out for the fish course. Experimental chef Stephen is determined to prove himself with a fish course honouring the WI's tradition of preserving, but he's up against stiff competition.

It's a battle for the main course with the Welsh chefs going head-to-head. With all three chefs paying homage to Welsh lamb; Adam with a refined dish, Phil with a dish dedicated to his Mum and Stephen with a lamb dish celebrating the WI.

It's the tricky dessert course and the last chance for the Welsh chefs to secure their place in tomorrow's regional final. With everything to play for, the pressure is fierce. Only two can make it through, and one will leave the competition for good.
The two remaining Welsh chefs cook their four courses again for the judges. One chef will be chosen to represent Wales in the national finals, taking them a step closer to cooking at the banquet.

Three of Northern Ireland's top chefs - Chris McGowan, Danni Barry and Ben Arnold - go head-to-head with their starter courses to impress this week's veteran judge. Former champion Chris is back for glory and determined to reach the banquet, but he's up against two newcomers with their sights firmly set on victory.

Chris McGowan, Danni Barry and Ben Arnold are cooking their fish courses. Ambitious Ben is determined to steal Chris's regional crown, but under fierce scrutiny from this week's formidable veteran, will the pressure to deliver spell melt down?
It's a battle for the main course for three of Northern Ireland's finest chefs - Chris McGowan, Danni Barry and Ben Arnold. Ambitious Ben is out to prove himself with a perfect lamb main course.

It's dessert day and the Northern Irish chefs are all striving for one of the two spots in the Regional Final. The pressure is intense, and in the end one chef must leave the competition empty-handed.

The two remaining North Irish chefs are cooking all four courses again for the judges - Prue Leith, Oliver Peyton and Matthew Fort. They're joined by a guest judge - award-winning food writer Felicity Cloake.

Mini Patel, Michael O'Hare and Tim Allen are going head-to-head this week for a chance to represent the North East region in the National Finals. Today it's a battle for starter course, and the first chance to impress their formidable veteran chef.

It's the fight for the fish course, as three of the North East's finest chefs - Mini Patel, Michael O'Hare and Tim Allen - are out to impress. After his risky starter caused a stir yesterday Michael is planning another controversial dish in honour of the WI's support of women's rights.

pr.t: Hitler's 9/11 - The Secret War on America
pr.d: A look at Hitler's bold plan during World War Two to send fighter planes into Manhattan skyscrapers for the psychological impact it would cause on the citizens in the United States and the world as a whole.
On April 6, 1862, the Confederate force's surprise attack against the Union in Shiloh, Tenn., results in some of the most brutal fighting of the Civil War.

Gen. Ulysses S. Grant's counter-attack at Shiloh, Tenn., leads to victory; thousands of escaping slaves seek refuge with Union forces advancing into the South; President Abraham Lincoln begins drafting a proclamation addressing slavery and freedom.

The Emancipation Proclamation ends slavery and gives blacks the freedom to fight; on July 4, 1863, the day after Pickett's Charge at Gettysburg, the Confederates surrender Vicksburg, Miss., to Gen. Grant.

The Confederate Army of Northern Virginia succeeds at splitting the Union Army in two during the Battle of Chickamauga; Gen. William Rosecrans is replaced by Gen. Ulysses S. Grant, who plans an offensive.
Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. Pre-Pearl Harbour, the US helped democracies and men joined the army to prepare for WW2 and Japan's threat.

Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. In 1942 the US had victories in the Doolittle Raid, Coral Sea and Midway while the Nazi's were taking Europe.

Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. Have a look at WW2 in 1943, where the battle turned against North Africa and plans were laid to bomb Germany.
Newsreel footage from the days of World War II, both on the home front and the battlefield. In 1944, the US waged global war towards Rome and the Pacific, and 6 June marked the D-Day landings.
The Battle of the Bulge continued in 1945 and the US battled stiff resistance on Leyte and Iwo Jima.

pr.t: The Voyage to the American Stonehenge
pr.d: University of Pennsylvania researcher Alexei Vranich sets out on an expedition to prove his theory of how the 'American Stonehenge' was created: the large, carved stones on the shores of Lake Titicaca, moved and worked by ancient people.
Scott Wolter believes America has its very own Stonehenge in New Hampshire. He explores if the Phoenicians are connected to both of these megalithic sites.
Forensic geologist Scott Wolter explores a government-restricted site in rural Georgia to find a connection between the ancient Mayans and the Track Rock.
Forensic geologist Scott Wolter investigates a burial site in the mountains of Arizona. It is possible that the rune stone belonged to a medieval Englishman.
Geologist Scott Wolter looks into the disappearance of copper from the area around Lake Superior. This could be proof of a prehistoric civilization.
Geologist Scott Wolter explores the possible existence of bones from a giant found in Minnesota. The Vikings could have travelled all the way to America.
Scott Wolter investigates the origins of a 500-pound boulder inscribed with a mysterious bull symbol. It could be linked to the rituals of an ancient people.

pr.t: Forbidden Knowledge: Forgotten Cities Lost in Time
pr.d: The filmmaker explores the lost underground cities of the ancient world.

In the mountains of China's Sichuan Province is the sight of hundreds of ancient wooden coffins hanging precariously from a cliff face. Some experts believe the dead were placed there thousands of years ago to be within reach of the gods.
He was one of the greatest generals the world has ever known. In just thirty-two years of life, Alexander the Great changed the course of civilisation forever.
Dan provides accounts of crusades, from the conquest of Jerusalem in 1099 to the Spanish Reconquista in 1492.
Tutankhamun, born 1340 BC, made religious changes after his father's reign.

Colourized rare archival film and home movies brings Churchill back to life. Includes moments of drama, alongside playful scenes with Charlie Chaplin and Churchill losing his shorts in his swimming pool.

Colourisation of historic film creates a vivid portrait of the Royal Family from the late 19th century onwards. Includes the earliest film of Queen Victoria, and Edward and Wallis Simpson marrying in exile.
Before the Unabomber, New Yorkers were terrified for 16 years by an attacker who planted bombs across the city. The culprit was an electrician named George Metesky.
The strange story of Michael Malloy shows how some people just won't die when you want them to.

Professor Alice Roberts explores British history through the stories of individual towns. Alice examines Britain in wartime by looking at the coastal town of Dover, a town that found itself on the frontline in the struggle against Nazi Germany.
Professor Alice Roberts explores the Georgian era in her hometown of Bristol, from architectural gems to the world's first chocolate factory, backstreet gin and the horror of the slave trade.
Alice Roberts explores the story of Stewart Britain by visiting Stirling, the home of the Scottish royals who eventually took the English throne in 1603 and created Great Britain.

A look at the biggest collection of Roman writing tablets in Britain, giving insight into what Roman London was really like. Off the coast of Kent, a dive into the English Channel reveals the biggest marine excavation since the Mary Rose, an 18th-century East India Company ship packed with silver.

Alice discovers the well-preserved writing tablets, swords and domestic items left by Romans at Vindolanda during a time of British rebellion. On the Scottish island of Iona, there are traces of a long-lost monastery and pilgrimage site that was originally built by the legendary Saint Columba, and has been compared to Jerusalem. In the east of Scotland, a weapons hoard belonging to a wealthy Bronze Age warrior is unearthed.
Kevin dives into the blue waters of the Caribbean to find the relics that litter the sea floor from piracy's heyday in the region.
pr.sub: The True Story of the Pirates of the Caribbean

pr.d: Kevin embarks on a challenging dive in the Atlantic Ocean to explore a battleship that saved the Northern Navy in the American Civil War.
pr.sub: Uss Monitor, Clash Of The Ironclads

pr.d: In York, Professor Alice Roberts takes part in a Viking battle, meets the metal detectorists behind one of the UK's greatest archaeological finds, and gets her hands on Viking poo.
Alice enjoys a Roman feast in Britain's most Roman city, Chester. She examines a radical theory on the Romans' plans for the city and explores an incredible archaeological find deep underground.
Andy searches for dragons in Somerset, visits the grave of Arthur and Guinevere and tests the healing waters of a spring once used to wash the Holy Grail.
Andy explores Wiltshire's mysterious megaliths and barrows, visits a medieval meadery and encounters a religious pilgrimage at the site of a freshly made crop circle.

The team are on the hunt for archaeology from the more recent past as they follow the search for artefacts from World War II. They join marine archaeologists in the Solent as they raise the once-in-a-lifetime find of a Fairey Barracuda dive bomber. More than 2,500 Barracudas were in service during the war but not a single complete plane survives today. Naoíse Mac Sweeney joins the post excavation to reveal how the find could help bring this rare aircraft back to life.

Alice and the team discover a series of intriguing Roman artefacts, including a bundle of coins in Somerset, and a man who was buried on a layer of dead animals. They also look into the mystery of 97 murdered babies.

In medieval England, the North was ruled from York. Dan Jones explores the history of its castle, from the Viking Jorvik and the Normans, through the dark days of the anti-Jewish pogrom and the imprisonment of the Knights Templar, to one of its most colourful inmates - the legendary highwayman Dick Turpin.

With the aid of dramatic reconstruction, Dan Jones explores the 900-year history of the beautiful Leeds Castle in Kent, from its origins as a royal Saxon family's manor and Norman stronghold to the private property of six medieval queens, a Tudor palace, a Jacobean country house, a Georgian mansion and an elegant 20th-century retreat for the rich and famous.
Alice Roberts explores the story of Stewart Britain by visiting Stirling, the home of the Scottish royals who eventually took the English throne in 1603 and created Great Britain.

Alice visits Canterbury for the story of Plantagenet England. Canterbury is steeped in history and the era of the Plantagenets - the strong house that held the English throne from 1154 until 1485 - saw the most dramatic episodes in the city's story.
Inspired by the story of his two cousins who died at sea in WWII, Ross Kemp explores the captured German scout warship, the F2, and brings up artefacts that could link back to his relatives.

Ross Kemp continues his adventure in Scapa Flow, plunging into the depths to see the wrecks of a German warship and an experimental submersible aircraft carrier named M2 that carried its own seaplane.
Delving into the often-overlooked history of America's next-door neighbour to explore the epic, violent and bloody struggles of Mexican culture and identity.
Throughout its history Mexico has been convulsed by a series of epic, violent and bloody struggles that have defined the culture and identity of this complex nation.
Kevin dives into the blue waters of the Caribbean to find the relics that litter the sea floor from piracy's heyday in the region.
pr.sub: The True Story of the Pirates of the Caribbean

Zum ersten Mal nimmt das Team zwei benachbarte Häuser in Angriff, die voller Unordnung sind.
Für diese Weihnachtsfans kann es rund um die Feiertage gar nicht genug Dekoration und Traditionen geben.

Nick reist in die geschichtsträchtige Küstenstadt Hastings, um Mike und seine vier Hunde zu besuchen. Gesundheitliche Probleme haben den einstigen Wanderer ausgebremst und seine Hütte versinkt im Chaos. Kann Nick sein Zuhause wieder bewohnbar machen?

Nick reist nach Kettering, wo ein Ehepaar mit zwei Kindern von seinem eigenen Zuhause überwältigt wird. Ihr Dreifamilienhaus ist überfüllt und chaotisch - so sehr, dass es nicht nur ihr Wohlbefinden, sondern sogar ihre Sicherheit gefährdet.

Nach einer Transplantation kämpft Elektriker Frank mit den strukturellen Mängeln seines Hauses, die ein früherer Auftragnehmer hinterlassen hat. Die Familie Holmes nimmt sich des Projekts an und setzt alles daran, das Haus sicher für Frank zu machen.

Die alleinerziehende Hilary aus San Diego will mit ihrer Tochter in ein Tiny House ziehen. Dabei bekommt sie Unterstützung von ihrer Freundin Diane. Hilary wünscht sich ein schlichtes, aber helles Häuschen mit offenem Grundriss.

James ist Fitness- und Outdoorenthusiast und sucht im Bundesstaat Washington ein Tiny House. Dabei hat er ein 28 Quadratmeter großes Haus im rustikalen Stil vor Augen, das eine kleine Küche, ein Schlafzimmer und genügend Platz bietet.

Mit 40.000 US-Dollar wollen sich Angela und Mac ein winziges Haus außerhalb von Greenville kaufen. Ein wenig Interessenkonflikt gibt es: Während Mac sich etwas Rustikales auf einfachem Fundament vorstellt, wünscht sich Angela eher etwas Mobiles.

Heather möchte sich ein Tiny House im Landhausstil in Steamboat Springs, Colorado, kaufen. Dabei wird sie von ihrer Mutter unterstützt, die das Budget im Blick hält. Dabei hat sie ein modernes und buntes Haus in Aussicht.

Acht Jahre in Kanada sind genug für ein Paar und ihre beiden kleinen Kinder. Sie ziehen in die Heimatstadt des Vaters, Freising. Während Michael seine Kindheitserlebnisse in Bayern an seine Kinder weitergeben möchte, hat Sky andere Vorstellungen.

Ein Szenenwechsel soll einem Paar mehr Ruhe schenken, als sie es in San Diego hatten. Kirsten freut sich auf einen Umzug nach Cabo San Lucas und ein stressfreies Leben. Doch Geldsorgen bei der Haussuche dämpfen die Vorfreude.

Sarah wurde eine Stelle als Schwimmlehrerin in Limerick, Irland, angeboten. Mit ihrem Freund Mark im Gepäck zieht das Paar um. Doch mit einem Budget von 1.400 US-Dollar im Monat kommen die beiden bei der Haussuche in Irland nicht weit.
pr.sub: Ein Königreich für ein eigenes Bad

pr.d: Erin, Sean, ihre beiden Töchter und zwei Hunde kommen aus Kalifornien. Als Sean eine Stelle in Bristol, England, angeboten wird, nimmt er sie zum Schreck seiner Frau an. Erin wollte ihren Lehrjob nach 18 Jahren nicht verlassen.

Nick und Raychel langweilen sich in Vancouver und erhoffen sich das Abenteuer ihres Lebens in Kambodscha. Nick ist Skater und fügt sich gut in das Leben in Phnom Penh ein. Raychel merkt dagegen, dass sie den westlichen Lebensstil vermisst.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Meistens ist es der Immobilienmarkt, auf dem neue Lotteriekönige zuerst einen Teil ihres Hauptgewinns anlegen möchten. Segelyacht, Luxuskarosse oder Weltraum-Safari - alles schöne Träume, aber Betongold funkelt doch am verführerischsten.
Carolyn, Brad und ihre Familie suchen nach einem zuhause, nachdem sie das Haus ihrer Oma verlassen.

Nach dem Umzug zurück nach Nashville, um näher bei der Familie zu sein, dauert die Wohnungssuche eines Paares länger als erwartet. Das Paar, das unbedingt aus dem Kinderzimmer herauskommen möchte, sucht ein eigenes, kinderfreundliches Traumhaus.

Ein Paar mit drei Kindern sucht nach einem Haus in "The Wildwoods", da der Vater dort einen neuen Job angenommen hat. Die Familie findet ein passendes Haus am Strand, das allerdings von Grund auf renoviert werden muss und ans Geld geht.

Mike und Nicole haben nach einigen gesundheitlichen Problemen beschlossen, sich in Morehead City ein neues Leben am Wasser aufzubauen. Idealerweise wünschen sie sich ein gemütliches Häuschen, das sich für den perfekten Strandurlaub eignet.

Ladenbesitzer Don und Künstlerin Kitty haben sich in ein Ferienhaus in Traumlage in Gulf Shores verliebt. Das Haus ist zwar etwas veraltet, mit etwas Farbe und ihrem Budget sollte es sich allerdings schnell aufwerten lassen.

Tamara und ihr Team nehmen sich einer riesigen, dunklen Villa mit toskanischem Flair an. Auf 8000 Quadratmetern wird jeder Raum neu gedacht und gestaltet. Das Ergebnis ist ein lichtdurchflutetes Anwesen mit außergewöhnlichen Details.

Ein jahrzehntelang vernachlässigtes Landanwesen wird von Tamara von Grund auf neugestaltet. Dunkle Räume und veraltete Materialien weichen einem zeitlosen Stil, der Eleganz und ländliche Ruhe verbindet. Jeder Raum wird neu designt.

Ein historisches Steinhaus liegt auf einem traditionsreichen Golfplatz und wartet auf neues Leben. Tamara und ihr Team verwandeln die ehemalige Immobilie des berühmten Golfschlägerbauers Kenneth Smith in ein stilvolles Investmentobjekt.
Josie und ihre Kinder bieten ihrer Mutter Maria ihre Hilfe an. Marias Gerümpel verstopft das Haus.
Mark, Arielle und ihre Kinder teilen sich ein Badezimmer und der Boden ist voller Kleiderstapel.

pr.t: Home Rescue - Wohnen in der Wildnis
pr.d: Marty, Matt und Misty sind bei einem Bauernhof in den Appalachen in West Virginia zu Besuch, auf dem mehr als 300 Tiere leben. Das Problem liegt jedoch darin, dass der Hof am Berg liegt, während die Trinkwasserquelle sich im Tal befindet.

pr.t: Home Rescue - Wohnen in der Wildnis
pr.d: Kristin und Sky Solbach leben auf der hawaiianischen Insel Maui. Tief im tropischen Dschungel wollen die Aussteiger ein selbstbestimmtes Leben führen. Doch gerade braut sich im Paradies ein heftiges Gewitter zusammen. Denn in der fünf Monate dauernden Regenzeit können sich Bäche und Flüsse schnell in reißende Ströme verwandeln. Das Grundstück war bereits mehrfach überflutet. Marty, Matt und Misty Raney sind zur Stelle, um die Solbachs im wahrsten Sinne des Wortes vor dem Untergang zu bewahren.

Vincent und seine Frau sind auf der Suche nach einer Immobilie, in die sie sich zurückziehen und sich von ihrem Alltag entspannen können. Sie werden am Desert Pond fündig. Chase Morill und sein Team helfen ihnen, die Immobilie herzurichten.

Eine Familie aus Maine hat ein großes Problem mit ihrer Immobilie aus den 70er Jahren. Denn damals wurde beim Anstrich von Häusern oft bleihaltige Farbe verwendet und es hat sich herausgestellt, dass diese gesundheitsgefährdend ist.

Jack reist nach Nevada, wo sich hinter der Fassade eines unscheinbaren Hauses ein Piratenschatz verbirgt. Danach besucht er ein außergewöhnliches Wohnhaus auf einer Brücke und entdeckt zum Abschluss in New Orleans ein Haus mit bewegter Vergangenheit.
Martin, Lucy and Dion visit a grand five-bedroom period house in Folkestone in Kent, a two-bedroom flat in London's Leytonstone and a two-bedroom mid-terrace in Fenton in Stoke-on-Trent.

A studio flat in a former 1960s office block which is grade two listed in London's Elephant and Castle, a terraced house in Pontygwaith in South Wales and a flat in Cradley Heath near Birmingham are all sold under the hammer.
A house with no floor in Edgbaston in Birmingham, a detached house on several levels in Oldham and a former garage complex ripe for development in Forest Hill in London are all sold under the hammer.
A converted 16th-century chapel in Matlock in Derbyshire, a two-bedroom flat in Whetstone in London and a water-damaged house in Wishaw in Scotland are all sold under the hammer.

A two-bed semi in Meir in Stoke-on-Trent is given a country house look, a flat in London's Willesden Green also gets the wow factor, and a semi in Dudley in the West Midlands loses its 1980s look to be brought into the 21st century.
Terraced houses in Gravesend in Kent and Shipley in Derbyshire are given a new lease of life while former church premises in Harrow Weald in Middlesex are given a new use for the community.

Martin, Lucy and Dion meet property developers who have all bought at auction and hope to make a profit on their investments. Today a landscape gardener tackles a terrace in Ilkeston in Derby, two friends take on a four-storey house in Sittingbourne in Kent while another couple of friends' first venture together is a studio flat in South Norwood in London.
The trio look at a family home in Kent, a former bar in Llanelli in Wales and a terrace in Croydon, all sold at auction. Will any of the developers make a return on their investments?

A three-bedroom semi in Crewe, a top-floor flat in London and a terraced house in Oldham are sold under the hammer. All the owners are happy with the prices they paid, but will any of them be able to turn a profit at the end of the projects?

While developers in Croydon in Surrey and Donnington in Shropshire wrestle with whether to lose a bedroom each for a better placed kitchen or bathroom, two friends in Derby consider creating two more in their six-bedroom house.

Two brothers buy a rundown cottage in Probus in Cornwall, a father buys a flat in Mitcham in Surrey as a long-term investment for his young daughter and a seasoned property developer buys a house in Tunstall in Stoke-on-Trent for her daughter.

Dion is in Plaistow in London looking around a three-bedroom semi, Lucy is checking out a small piece of land in Crayford in Kent, and Martin meets a father and son who have bought a small house with a big garden in Wheelock in Cheshire.
A former miner's cottage in Aberaman in South Wales and semis in Adderley Green in Stoke and Streatham in South London are all sold under the hammer.
Martin, Lucy and Dion look around auction buys in Birmingham, Oldham and Gravesend and discover what the new owners plan to do with their investments.
Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin are in Stoke, Croydon in London and Warrington hearing tales from the auction rooms.

A former doctor's surgery in need of TLC is converted into a family home in Houghton-le-Spring. Also, a flat in a 1930s block of flats in Edgware and a detached house in a woodland garden in Ashford in Kent are also given makeovers.

Three developers have very different reasons for making their investments: there's a family home in Consett in County Durham, a rental investment in Derby and an auction buy in Beckenham in London which will be used to run a new business, which the owner hopes will give him more time with his family.

Dion looks round a large Victorian terrace in Plumstead, Martin is in Mickleover in Derby hearing a father and daughter's plans for a flat and Lucy discovers what happened to a plot of land she saw five and a half years ago.

Martin looks round a bungalow in a stunning setting in the Lake District while Dion has a look at a flat close to Nottingham city centre. Lucy meets a woman who mistakenly thought she was buying a piece of land in Folkestone in Kent.
Lucy looks at a flat in Kilburn in London with one of the worst cases of damp she has ever seen, while Martin and Dion are in the Midlands looking round semis with potential.
A flat with huge potential in London's Earlsfield, and terraced houses in Wombourne near Wolverhampton and Ynyswen near Treorchy in Wales are all sold under the hammer.

Martin is impressed with the potential of two shops and three flats in Tonypandy in Wales while Dion looks round a two-bedroom maisonette in Dawley and Lucy meets a first-time developer with ambitious plans for an end terrace in London's Forest Gate.

Anthony is an Iraq War veteran who wears his Purple Heart on his sleeve. Over a year ago, he bonded online with a caring, emotionally available man named Marq. They are head over heels in love, but what is Marq hiding?
A man says his child's mother stole his personal records.
A teenager's jokes lead to vandalism. A babysitter, who says the children she watched were out of control, is sued for the return of wages she received in advance.
A woman accuses her former live-in friend of wrecking her car. Gambling losses, the cost of cruise tickets and alleged cheating are contested when unwed parents fight over a trip they took together.
A teenager denies stealing $600 from a friend's glove compartment. A woman is blamed when her car is dinged by a golf ball.

Presumed dead, the sisters start their demon-free existence with new identities brought about by a spell that altered their appearances to the outside world, but not to those closest to them. Phoebe is surprised to see Dex Lawson, and now able to have a normal family life, Piper remains paranoid that the demons will find out the sisters are still alive. Also, Paige realises that she spent too much time in the magic world.

Hoping to lure the Charmed Ones out of hiding, Haas, a young demon wanting to take over the Underworld, uses the 'Alice in Wonderland' fairy tale to prey on young victims. When Billie stumbles upon his plan and tries to stop him, she becomes one of his victims. The sisters decide to come to Billie's rescue. Also, Phoebe tries to get to know Dex better under her new identity.

A mystery email leads Nev and Laura to help Derek track down his online love, Annabelle. After some investigation, they uncover a sexy Snapchat scandal, betrayal, and a conclusion that hits closer to home than Derek expected.
A former friend sues a teen for wrecking his car by hitting a speed-limit sign and the recipient of a $3,000 loan says it was a gift.
An assault with a baseball bat is disputed by a young man and his former boss. A Bradford pear tree crashes to the ground after it is hit by a car when a young woman slides off the icy road.
Being too drunk to remember what happened is a driver's defence after he wrecks his child's mother's car; a truck loan and physical threats end a friendship.
Unaware of the reason her boyfriend is in jail, a woman sues his friend for the return of a vehicle; dog owners dispute liability and veterinary bills after one's pet attacks the other.

Looking for a new career path, Piper goes for an interview with a corporate recruitment consultant, but is soon arrested when a background check reveals that the physical appearance she adopted was that of a woman wanted for murder. The sisters set out to clear the woman's name, but are impressed when Billie is the one who comes up with the perfect plan. Meanwhile, Phoebe has a premonition of an earthquake striking.

Wyatt's impending school play brings out the competitive nature in Piper when her hand-sewn costume and her parenting skills are attacked by Stepford Wife Mandi. Unbeknown to Piper, Mandi is a demon in disguise, who wants to kidnap Wyatt and use his powers to bring back The Source and create the perfect demon family.
Neighbours blame each other when their cars collide. Clients sue a private investigator for the return of fees.
A woman says that her family vandalised her car, and former friends fight over liability for car damages.
Amber steps into the ring, Chloe and Jordan both fight for their relationship to succeed, while the gloves come off for Sassi and Darren as they unite for Zena'ya's birthday party.

Albert is neither the most attractive nor the most confident man in the world, so when he falls in love with one of his firm's clients, Allegra Cole, he calls in an expert to help him win her over. Hitch is the business name of Alex Hitchins, and he earns his pay by teaching men how to woo the girl of their choice.
Will football-mad MGK who compares love interests to FIFA cards meet his match on Soho's streets? And will Kim be able to persuade Geona - who only dates the oldest siblings - to open her heart?
Three men disappear from a yacht in Australia; people vanish from a remote Vermont mountaintop; a pilot is stalked by unidentified aircraft.

A ship with incredible misfortune, the MS Achille Lauro suffered two serious collisions, multiple onboard fires, and even witnessed the murder of a passenger after being hijacked by PLO terrorists in 1985.
After losing power in a storm off South Africa in 1991, Oceanos was abandoned by many of her crew, including the negligent captain, leaving hundreds of passengers stranded on board.
Exploring the possibility of alien involvement in the creation of enduring structures on Earth.
Ex-U.S. Intelligence officer Grusch tells the Oversight Committee about an alien craft in U.S. secret facilities.
A man in Missouri films what looks like a metal cube spinning in the sky. Something very similar is seen in LA, Texas and Columbia.
A mysterious opening on the Red Planet caught on camera, a UFO appears to invade an Amazon village, and an unidentified spacecraft disrupts the queen's jubilee celebrations in London in June 2022.
A ghost ship is found on a remote island, home to one of Earth's last uncontacted tribes. New evidence reveals a mysterious military compound in Russia.
A man changes personalities after a heart transplant and perfect circles of ice are formed. A mother is unrelated to her biological children.

Craig and Sarah take on the US Navy's Unidentified Aerial Phenomenon videos: the 'Tic-Tac' footage, filmed from the USS Nimitz in 2004, and the 'Go-Fast' and 'Gimbal' videos filmed between 2014 and 2015 from the USS Theodore Roosevelt.

Craig and Sarah pore over every scrap of available evidence relating to the Rendlesham incident, including the audio recording made by Lieutenant Colonel Charles Halt when he and a patrol of men investigated lights in the forest that fateful night.

On a September morning in 1994, students at a Zimbabwe school witness a silver craft land in a nearby field. Numerous adults corroborate the UFO sighting, but the children are silenced. Many maintain their account of the incident is true.
60 years on, Tony's close encounter has become an obsession. Meanwhile, pilot David presents photographic evidence of the UFO he almost crashed into whilst flying near area 5.
Adam, Gwen and Julie recall personal encounters with UFOs, before experts' theories are put in doubt when we learn that each individual has time missing from their encounters.

Delving into how a grievously injured skull changed the face of neuroscience, asking if World War II really could have been won by a bat, and investigating if people made sophisticated multipurpose tools 14,000 years ago.
pr.sub: The Skull That Changed Science, the Bat Bomb and the Stone Age Multitool

pr.d: Exploring a 5,000-year-old carved stone object shaped into four symmetrical lobes covered in unique markings, why people believed an electrocution device could cure, and a 3,000-year-old cat mummy with no cat inside.
pr.sub: The Stone Ball, the Electrocution Belt and the Cat Mummy That Wasn't

Whether life remains on Mars, and how it may have evolved.
Some places in the world record more UAP sightings than the rest, attracting people hoping to glimpse a flying saucer.
A look at UAPs seen diving into oceans at high speeds and the possibility that they seek refuge in Earth's depths.
A US navy warship is orbited by UFOs. Meanwhile, a British TV programme is interrupted by a voice claiming to be from the Ashtar Galactic Command, warning that Earth is in danger.

A UFO is caught on camera by a military helicopter on the Mexican border, an English woman is filmed disappearing from her bed at night, and NASA investigates UFOs after years of denial by the US authorities.

Can satellite images help identify the hiding place of the Nazi Gold Train? Also, a blood-red river in Siberia points to pollution on a catastrophic scale and a discovery of a long-lost settlement rewrites the history of the Vikings in North America.

Annually, Illinois gets more than 300 UFO reports, so why are the Tinley Park sightings - with over 70 witnesses each year - the only reports that happen en masse?
A fascinating look at the mounting evidence that suggests UFO waves are able to penetrate the world's most closely guarded airspace at will.
Aliens may be interested in experimenting on the human mind and body, and the human civilisation may be aliens' prized experiment.

Cleopatra attempts to restore the power of the early pharaohs through alliances with the most powerful men in the world. Her clash with Octavian at the battle of Actium leads to the rise of an emperor.
During the Cold War, sinister objects were seen flying above secret military bases. Were aliens monitoring the world's nuclear arsenal?
Legends of ancient giants surround a mysterious monument in the Holy Land. Plus, when a boy disappears, satellite images help with the investigation.
A ghost town covered in a strange, white powder emerges from a lake in Argentina. Plus, a declassified CIA image uncovers a bizarre, giant Soviet weapon.

Situated high on a crag overlooking the river Forth, Stirling Castle has guarded the gateway to the Scottish Highlands for centuries. The residence of kings, armies and felons, its battle-scarred walls have witnessed savagery and chivalry, intrigue, alchemy, adultery and murder. Location filming, stunning aerial shots and reconstructions bring to life its turbulent history.
Kevin embarks on a challenging dive in the Atlantic Ocean to explore a battleship that saved the Northern Navy in the American Civil War.
pr.sub: Uss Monitor, Clash Of The Ironclads

A powerful earthquake in 208 seemed to lead to an increase in UFO sightings in Alaska - but why? Do the extraterrestrials have something to protect here?
From loss of time and bizarre hazy memories, to terrifying accounts of alien surgery, these are the hidden signs of alien abduction.
In order to survive mankind must find a way to navigate the galaxy. Alien encounters have offered a possible glimpse into the secrets of interstellar flight.

After a dazzling midnight spectacle in the sky, a local photographer's malfunctioning car barely makes it home, only for her to discover that what was so interesting may have followed her home. With exoplanet LP 791-18 d in the cross-hairs as a potential home to the unsettling visitors, experts speculate about what exactly they may be after.
In the 80s and 90s, sightings of dark, triangular flying objects began to occur across the world - many incidents remaining unexplained.
Investigators find a new clue about the Malaysia Airlines flight that disappeared in 2014. Plus, an astronaut spots something strange in the Sahara Desert.
A forest of razor-sharp stones could be home to an undiscovered humanoid species. Satellite imagery reveals a mysterious eye-shaped island in a swamp.
Andy explores an ancient cavern, takes a tour of Dartmoor's prison museum and uncovers the legend behind Arthur Conan Doyle's 'The Hound of the Baskervilles'.

Im Jahr 1939 begann mit den Angriffen auf Polen offiziell der Zweite Weltkrieg. Besonders über der Stadt Warschau warfen die Flugzeuge ihre Bomben ab. Die Moral der Bevölkerung zu brechen galt als vorrangiges Ziel dieser Angriffe.

Der Einmarsch der Deutschen in Polen markiert den Beginn des Zweiten Weltkriegs. Als Folge löst dies eine Kettenreaktion weiterer internationaler Konflikte aus. Japan will aggressiv expandieren, Afrika wird zu einem strategisch wichtigen Schauplatz.

Im Jahr 1941 beginnt Hitlers Invasion der UdSSR mit der Operation "Barbarossa", die zunächst erfolgreich ist. Der Vormarsch kommt jedoch zum Erliegen, als der Winter einsetzt und der sowjetische Widerstand durch Propaganda gestärkt wird.
The programming for this time slot has yet to be determined and is being confirmed by the broadcast channel.

Deutschland erlitt 1943 in Stalingrad eine entscheidende Niederlage, während Japan im Pazifik nach dem US-Sieg bei Guadalcanal an Boden verlor. Diese Ereignisse führten zu einem strategischen Umschwung im Zweiten Weltkrieg.

Der D-Day im Jahr 1944 eröffnet eine neue Front im Westen, während gleichzeitig die "Operation Bagration" die Wehrmacht im Osten zerschmettert. Diese militärischen Aktionen markieren den Beginn des Untergangs des Dritten Reichs.

In der Mojave-Wüste entdecken Forscher auf Satellitenfotos etwas, das sechzig Mal größer ist als New York City. Außerdem folgen Archäologen dem Rätsel um einen riesigen Handabdruck, der auf einer schwedischen Insel in Felsen gehauen wurde.

Seilbahnen und Standseilbahnen faszinieren durch ihre Ingenieurskunst und bieten spektakuläre Ausblicke, doch seltene Unfälle sind oft tödlich. Diese Vorfälle erinnern daran, dass selbst die sichersten Fahrten versteckte Gefahren bergen können.

pr.t: Der Vatikan - Geheimnisse der Heiligen Stadt
pr.d: Der Vatikan ist der kleinste anerkannte Staat der Welt. Doch dort ist eine ganze Menge los. Unzählige Gläubige pilgern jährlich dorthin. Außerdem finden sich dort große Teile des Welterbes - von Petrus' Grab bis hin zum Petersdom.

Am internationalen Newark Liberty Flughafen versuchen Passagiere Schmuggelware aus Ägypten einzuführen - darunter einen Beutel mit Kuhmist. Pro Kopf verzehrt der Deutsche 38,1 Kilogramm Schweinefleisch im Jahr. Die Dokumentation zeigt den Weg des Nahrungsmittels vom Tier bis auf den Teller. Ein Gutshof in Bayern setzt auf glückliche Tiere, Bio und Handarbeit.
pr.sub: Vom Schwein zum Schnitzel - Hinter den Kulissen der Fleischindustrie

pr.d: Der Burger ist ein beliebter Imbiss. Mittlerweile dringen immer mehr inhabergeführte Restaurants auf den Markt. Wie sieht es hinter den Bedientheken in deutschen Burger-Läden aus? Welches Geschäftsmodell überzeugt: Massenware oder Handarbeit?

Die moderne Küche soll schick, modern und repräsentativ sein. Dabei sind die Grundzüge der verschiedenen im Handel erhältlichen Modelle gleichermaßen einander ähnlich wie simpel. Küchen werden aus mehreren Schranktypen und E-Geräten zusammengestellt.
pr.sub: Die Küchenmacher - Von Maßarbeit bis Massenware

pr.d: Moderne Landwirtschaft ist ohne sie undenkbar: riesige Erntemaschinen. Die Reportage sieht sich auf der Messe "Agritechnica" um, ist bei einem Ernteeinsatz in Vorpommern dabei und zeigt, mit welchem Aufwand die Maschinen transportiert werden.

In Newark geraten Beamte bei einer Frachtkontrolle an brisante Funde: Drogen, gefälschte Handtaschen, Medikamente. In Honolulu verweigert ein Passagier jedes Wort. Doch sein Handy deutet klar auf Drogenkonsum hin. San Francisco wird zum Schauplatz einer riskanten Festnahme - ein Gesuchter wird direkt nach der Landung gestellt. Der Mann beteuert lautstark seine Unschuld. Drei Flughäfen, drei Fälle voller Spannung - und die Frage: Haben die Beamten wirklich den Richtigen?

Trotz striktem Kontaktverbot möchte ein Mann zu seiner Frau ins Flugzeug steigen - die Beamten müssen sofort handeln. In Atlanta entdecken Fahnder in Videospiel-Verpackungen dreiste Fälschungen. Und in San Francisco glaubt eine Passagierin, Luxusgüter im Wert von 200.000 Dollar einfach "vergessen" zu können. Sekunden entscheiden, ob Recht und Ordnung triumphieren. Drei Flughäfen, drei heikle Fälle - ein Tag voller Einsätze am Limit.
Zollbeamten treffen auf eine Person mit jeder Menge Gold, Silber und Diamanten im Gepäck. Außerdem finden Beamten einen Mann, der von der Polizei gesucht wird.

An der Grenze gerät ein amerikanischer Bauarbeiter in ernsthafte Schwierigkeiten. An einem anderen Ort des Landes finden Beamte Lithiumbatterien mit sonderbarem Inhalt, der deswegen eine detailliertere Untersuchung erfordert.
Eine Frau aus Hongkong wird verdächtigt, da sie zur Besichtigung eines zerstörten Hauses anreist.
Die Beamten ertappen einen Drogenschmuggler aus Brasilien und ein Mann flieht vor Kredithaien.
Der Zoll findet eine große Menge Zigaretten und ein liebeskranker Litauer bittet um Nachsicht.

Ein nigerianischer Staatsbürger wird mit Grenzschutzbeamten konfrontiert. Der Zoll findet ein äußerst verdächtiges Paket aus Afrika. Währenddessen spricht die Einwanderungsbehörde mit einem DJ, der versucht, ohne Visum zu arbeiten.

In dieser Folge versucht ein britischer Staatsbürger, sein Land zu verlassen. Außerdem trifft im Postzentrum ein mysteriöses Paket ein und Beamte vom Zoll und Polizei sind auf der Suche nach einem Boot in der Bay of Islands.

In dieser Folge entdecken die Beamten eine lebende Katze im Handgepäck einer Touristin. Außerdem wird ein unscheinbares Plüschtier als Drogenversteck entlarvt und die Einsatzkräfte müssen zwei Einheimische auf dem Wasser wieder zur Vernunft bringen.

Die Einwanderungsbehörde hat es mit einem Mann aus Singapur zu tun, der behauptet, ein Rendezvous mit einem geheimnisvollen Mann zu haben. Außerdem verursacht eine Überschwemmung in der Biosicherheitszone vom Flughafen von Auckland einen Ausfall.

Der Koffer eines brasilianischen Mannes wird hochgenommen, da sich Kokain in ihm befindet. Außerdem kann sich eine Frau bei der Biosicherheit nicht gut benehmen und die Frau eines Mannes versucht, seine Misstaten zu vertuschen.
