Pedro gets a cough at playschool and the other children soon catch it. Doctor Brownbear is called and gives them horrible medicine, but who will look after him when he is ill?
Peppa and her friends are playing hide and seek, but it is Freddy Fox with his super-smelling nose who is the best at playing that game.

Peppa takes Goldie the Goldfish for a visit to the vets and is surprised when she finds that there's a new road to be built over the building! With the help of Mr. Bull and his brother they find that instead of demolishing the vets they can build a tunnel underneath it.
Peppa and her family share a picnic with Mr Zebra the Postman and Zoe Zebra, but when it's time to go home, Peppa leaves her teddy behind.
Peppa and George are visiting their big cousin Chloe and will get to meet Chloe's new baby brother Alexander for the first time.
It's a very cold winter's day, and Peppa and George head to the park to play, but all the puddles have frozen over, so the two must think of other ways to entertain themselves.
George enjoys seeing his reflection in the mirror so much that he and Peppa try to find other shiny things to see themselves in.
Peppa gets shiny new red shoes and never wants to take them off, until it's time to jump in muddy puddles.
Peppa and George enjoy helping Grandpa Pig plant seeds in his garden.
Granny Pig shows Peppa and George her poultry. Elsewhere, something has been eating Grandpa Pig's lettuces.
Grandpa Pig takes Peppa, George and Danny Dog to visit Grampy Rabbit's lighthouse.
Daddy teaches Peppa and George a fun game to play while they wait inside for the rain to stop.
Peppa and George visit Daddy Pig's office and meet his colleagues. Mr Rabbit works with numbers, while Mrs Cat seems to spend her time drawing shapes on a computer.
Peppa and her friends go on a camping trip with their teacher, Madame Gazelle. After pitching their tents and collecting sticks, they all sing a song around the campfire.
A new student, Gerald the giraffe, joins the playgroup where Peppa and her friends go. However, when he tries to fit in, he finds it difficult to play hide-and-seek because he is so tall.
Peppa's family are at Digger World, where they have fun building walls and knocking them over again, and even help Mr Bull when there's an obstacle in the road.
George finds a very friendly spider in the bathroom. Peppa is very frightened until she realises that the little spider doesn't want to hurt her. She names him Mister Skinny legs.
Delphine the donkey comes to stay. Peppa takes Delphine to playgroup, where they teach her the 'Bing Bong Song'.
Mummy Pig gives her old computer to Granny and Grandpa Pig. They use it for lots of important work, as well as Happy Mrs Chicken, but when it breaks they are not sure who will fix it.
Peppa and her friends go to help at Edmond Elephant's birthday party, but the little children are harder to look after than they'd thought.
Peppa and George go to the seaside with Granny and Grandpa Pig and realise not all beaches are sandy. This one has lots of rocks and little rock pools to explore.
The doctor teaches children what to do if there is ever an accident. A patient soon appears, and they put into practise the new techniques they have learned.
There's a spider in the house. Mummy Pig tells Daddy Pig to get rid of it. Mr Skinny-Legs is set free in the garden, where he can spin all the webs he likes.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel visit Peppa's playgroup. They offer two lucky children the chance to spend the day with them.
Miss Rabbit is teaching the children a swimming lesson, They start out by swimming with floats tucked under their arms.
Features the grown-up's singing competition where the kids are the judges.
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first?

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.

Peppa and her friends are at playgroup and today Madame Gazelle would like them all to play music. They think they are playing with normal instruments, but today the children must make their own instruments. Madame Gazelle gathers bits and bobs of old packaging and shows them how to make their own. At the end of the day, they put on a special concert for the parents.
George and Peppa spend the day playing golf with Grandpa Pig, but they are much more interested in the colourful mini-golf course next door.
On a day out with her family, Peppa is encouraged to find words to describe the different kinds of puddles they find.
Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit pretend to be babies to get Mummy Rabbit's attention. Mummy Rabbit plays along until they admit they are not really babies!

Dr Hamster has brought a giant ant farm and opens the ant farm's lid to show how they got in. Nobody noticed they escaped and starting moving things in the classroom! The children place food around to lead the ants safely back.
Peppa is playing at Suzy's house, and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in. She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio for her to make things.

It is raining, and Grandpa Rabbit has built a rocket pack. As he demonstrates it to Peppa and George, he inadvertently ends up atop a snowy mountain. Miss Hare attempts to rescue him but becomes stranded on the mountaintop as well.
At the climbing centre, Grampy Rabbit teaches the children about mountain climbing. For the really high climbing wall, Grampy attaches safety ropes to the children so they don't fall.
A new synthesiser arrives for Daddy Pig, and his family collect sounds for it from around the house while he is out at work.
On a cold day, Daddy Pig suggests they build a den until Mummy Pig has finished work. After a hard day's work, the cushion den is a perfect place to watch TV together!
Peppa and her family are on a caravan adventure; the first stop is the biggest potato in the world; when it starts to get too foggy, they park up for a rest before another busy day.

Peppa and her friends are at the clubhouse. They are playing at serving takeaway food. The children assign themselves different roles, including a cook and a waiter. Once the imaginary food is ready, they have fun delivering it.
Peppa and George play with walkie-talkies at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandpa Pig teaches Peppa and George how to use codenames to talk using the gadgets.
Mummy Pig dresses as a firefighter to practise fighting fires at the fire station with the other mummies. The fire brigade demonstrates how to do so effectively using their motto, Ready, Steady, Go.
For World Book Day, the playgroup must dress up as a character from their favourite book. But Peppa can't decide which as she has so many favourites.

When a storm cancels Peppa and her family's outdoor adventure plans, they decide to bring the fun indoors. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and enjoy a campfire in the attic.
At Chloe's birthday party, the children and grownups struggle to finish the inflatable obstacle course to reach the prize.
Peppa and her friends, accompanied by Mummy Sheep and Granny Sheep, take Vanessa to Grampy Rabbit's boatyard for inspiration. The children create various artworks using items found around the yard.

Peppa and her friends head to the trampoline park where Miss Rabbit shows them how to bounce. As Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Mummy Sheep watch the children play, they decide they want to have a go at trampolining.
Peppa's playgroup are really enjoying Grampy Rabbit's talk about space rockets, until suddenly he loses his voice. Doctor Brown Bear must get him speaking again.

Peppa goes to her first ballet lesson, and meets her friends Candy, Suzy, Rebecca, Danny and Pedro there. She decides to teach Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig to dance but finds out they have some moves of their own.
George is upset when he loses his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur. Peppa becomes a detective to track it down.
The family have a special day planned for George's birthday. They visit the museum and see dinosaurs, before ending the day with cake.
Daddy Pig loses his title as Champion Puddle Jumper until everyone helps him train to win it back.
Madame Gazelle introduces a new pupil to the playgroup, Emily Elephant, and everyone wants to be her friend because she's very good at building blocks and can make a very loud noise with her trunk.
Peppa, George and Daddy are in the garden painting a picture of a cherry tree when the ducks turn up and run through the paint, and all over their masterpiece.

Mummy Sheep gets the news that she has got a new job far away, leaving Suzy and Peppa to wonder how they're going to carry on being best friends; Peppa gives Suzy some presents to remember her by, before a surprising change for Mummy Sheep changes everything.

Peppa and her friends are busy building a desert island in a sandpit. They are all very proud of it, with its forest, lake, houses and shops. It's going splendidly, until George and Richard's dinosaurs turn up.
Peppa and George discover frogs, worms and butterflies in Granny Pig and Grandpa Pig's garden, and they play with them. Then Peppa, George and Grandpa have fun jumping in muddy puddles.
Peppa teases George because he can't catch a ball properly. Mummy Pig suggests they play a game that will help George learn how to catch, called 'Piggy in the Middle'.
It is Danny Dog's birthday, and with the help of Grandad Dog and Grandpa Pig the children take part in a pirate treasure hunt.
Baby Alexander is too young to talk until Peppa teaches him his first word.
Peppa and George realise that they have shadows and no matter what they do, they can't escape from them.

Madame Gazelle and the playgroup are sharing their favourite nursery rhymes. From singing Little Bo Peep to marching along with The Grand Old Duke of York, everyone enjoys listening to each other's choice.
Peppa wins her first star for making a wonderful drawing of her house. Dad realises that he has never won a single star and is determined to solve the problem.
Mummy and Daddy Pig take Peppa and George to a castle to feast on medieval banquets, play King and Queen, and even meet a dragon. It is George's favourite day ever.

The Carnival has come to town, and it's a chance to see all sorts of exciting things! There is Mr. Bull's Jazz Band, Miss Rabbit as the Carnival Queen and even a very special appearance from Mr. Potato.
Peppa and George are at the playground with their friends. Peppa loves to play on the swings, but George is a bit afraid of heights and doesn't like to be pushed too high.
Daddy Pig and Mr Bull are digging up the playground, so Daddy Pig decides to teach the kids some simple science. The first experiment is to see how many children it takes to pick up Madame Gazelle.

It is Molly Mole's first day at school and she quickly makes best friends with Peppa and Rebecca Rabbit. Molly shows them how good she is at digging while taking them on a tour of her underground house.

Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy Pig have gone to visit Madame Gazelle. The family soon realise that her house is being pushed over by the tall tree next to it. Mr. Bull arrives and with his help they all manage to save Madame Gazelle's House and tree.
Madame Gazelle shows Peppa and her school friends how to make a time capsule, with each of them putting one of their favourite things in the capsule and burying it in the school garden.
When Peppa and George go to the dentist for a check-up, Dr Elephant says their teeth are nice and white, but George's toy dinosaur is in need of a tooth clean.
Peppa and George learn some wonderful magic words. Nice things happen when they say please and thank you.

While Peppa and her friends are at playgroup, Madame Gazelle tells them about a lucky hamper of goodies they are going to make and place in a charity raffle. The project is a huge success, as the children gather fruit from their homes.
Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa Pig's garden, where Granny's friends are playing folk music. After they perform for Grandpa Pig, he treats everyone to freshly made apple juice.
Peppa is playing with Freddy Fox at his home, in a flat above the shops. Peggy and Pandora Panda and Candy Cat live there too, and help show Peppa around.

At the playground, Pedro and Penny's glasses fall off; both think that their glasses are broken, as they cannot see very well; Madame Gazelle shows Pedro and Penny different types of objects with lenses.
Peppa looks after Madame Gazelle's guinea pigs Ginger and Brian while she goes on holiday, but they prove to be more trouble for Mummy and Daddy Pig than they think.
Peppa and her friends are in a playgroup and Mr Bull is building a wind turbine. Madame Gazelle explains everything to the children about wind energy.
Mummy Pig suggests the family all make pizzas together, so everyone prepares and chooses the food to make their own individual pizzas.
Peppa and her family hire a canoe from Miss Rabbit. They imagine they are in a jungle and then unexpectedly bump into Mrs Crocodile. Later on, Mr Lion invites them to have a picnic.
There's a new friend for Peppa at her playgroup, Lotte Lama. She can speak a foreign language, and Peppa loves talking. Everyone loves talking.
Peppa is excited to help George explore the world of sounds now he has his hearing aid. She shows him her favourite sounds including the splashing of jumping in a muddy puddle!
Peppa, her friends, and their parents, learn woodworking from Mister Wolf. He asks Daddy Pig to make a hut out of twigs, but it isn't very strong, and Mister Wolf manages to blow it down.
Mummy and Daddy Pig get stuck behind Mrs Badger's tractor on the way to her farm, where Peppa and George learn about how useful tractors can be, even if they aren't very fast.
Grampy Rabbit teaches Danny Dog and Peppa why his lifeboat is so important when it comes to saving lives at sea and gives them tips on how to stay safe.
Pedro loves superheroes. He has a superhero party and Super Potato is one of the guests. Together, they play some party games and Super Potato gets to show everyone his superpowers.
At the playgroup, Madame Gazelle is reading the children a story, but a page is missing so she makes up an ending. During playtime, the children make up their own alternative endings.

Peppa and friends are at Penny Polar Bear's house for a movie night; before they can watch it, the children need to decide where to sit, which popcorn to eat and take a toilet break -- then they're finally ready.
Peppa and her friends are playing in their clubhouse, which has a fold-down counter at the front. The children pretend to run a little shop for the parents to buy things from.

Peppa and her friends come to school early to have breakfast together. They learn about how food gives you energy and talk about their favourite breakfast foods. They all end up having toast with fun toppings. Finally, they have a good stretch and dance to get ready for the day and all sing the breakfast song.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel visit Peppa's playgroup. They offer two lucky children the chance to spend the day with them.
Miss Rabbit is teaching the children a swimming lesson, They start out by swimming with floats tucked under their arms.
Features the grown-up's singing competition where the kids are the judges.
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first?

Peppa and her family oversee the building of a large remodel to their home to accommodate the new baby, but things go awry when Daddy Pig's blueprints get swapped for George's plans for a robot house.
Oh dear, Miss Rabbit's train has broken down and all her passengers need to get to work. So Grandpa Pig lends Miss Rabbit his little train, Gertrude.
pr.sub: Grandpa Pig's Train to the Rescue

pr.d: What's that strange creature hovering in the sky? It's George's dinosaur balloon, but little George is finding it difficult to keep hold of his big balloon. Can anyone stop it from flying off to the moon?
Peppa's older cousin Chloe comes to visit, and Peppa must play games by somebody else's rules for a change.
Some of Daddy Pig's important work papers have gone missing because Mummy Pig, Peppa and George have accidentally made them into paper aeroplanes.
Peppa and family are at the school fair where the top prize in the raffle is a hot-air balloon ride.
Grandpa Pig needs help when his boat sinks, so Granddad Dog gives them all a lift to Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard so that the boat can be fixed.
The children's favourite teacher, Madame Gazelle, is leaving Playgroup. They are very sad to be losing her, but decide to throw a leaving party to give her a good send-off.
Peppa and George explore the greenhouse, and it is full of lovely tomatoes and basil. When it is time for dinner, Granny Pig takes all the ingredients they have grown and makes a tasty salad.

Daddy Pig receives a letter saying he must go away on business to test some very important concrete. Peppa, Mummy and George all decide to go with Daddy and enjoy a train journey, where they sing to pass the time.
After smelling Granny Pig's perfume de lavender, Peppa experiments with the flowers in the garden to create her own special smell.
Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy enjoy flying a kite in the park until their kite gets tangled in a tree beside a big, muddy puddle.

George joins Peppa at her playgroup today. Peppa doesn't really want George to be there. It's her playgroup after all. Then George is an instant hit with all of Peppa's friends. They think he's 'brilliant'.
Peppa brings home a teddy from playgroup to look after, but she is worried that he will not have a very exciting time.
Miss Rabbit gives Mummy Pig, Peppa and George a ride in her rescue helicopter. Daddy Pig is very sad to miss all the fun, but Miss Rabbit makes sure that doesn't happen.
Peppa and George are excited when Mr Zebra delivers a package from Aunt Dottie, who lives abroad, but they have different ideas about what they want to name their new toy.
Peppa's playgroup is holding a jumble sale to raise money for a new roof and Madame Gazelle asks everyone to bring something to sell. Peppa and each of her friends bring in an old toy.
On a beautiful sunny day, Grandpa takes Peppa and George to spend the day sailing. After an accident, the boat ends up sinking, and now they need rescuing with a hovercraft.
Goldie the Goldfish is feeling a little lonely, so Peppa takes her to the aquarium. With all the different fish there, Peppa must find a new friend for Goldie.

Daddy Pig loves to watch television, but Peppa Pig thinks that he needs to do some exercise. She says that Daddy Pig's tummy is looking a bit big. Daddy Pig disagrees but says that Peppa can be in charge of getting him fit. Peppa gives him lots of exercises to do, and Daddy Pig is exhausted by the end of the day.
Peppa and her family visit Uncle Pig, Aunty Pig and Cousin Chloe. Chloe has a new puppet theatre, and she helps Peppa and George to make puppets. After lunch, they put on a very funny puppet show.

Richard Rabbit comes to play with George, while Suzy Sheep plays with Peppa. The boys don't want to play the same games as the girls, but they all agree that they like jumping up and down in muddy puddles.
When it comes to pancake making, Daddy Pig thinks he is a bit of an expert, but he has a tendency to flip the pancakes a bit too high.
George, Peppa and Mummy Pig head off to Miss Rabbit's clothes shop to get George some brand-new clothes. After trying on lots of new exciting outfits George finds an outfit that suits him just right!
At the park, all the leaves have turned red and yellow, and it's so windy that Peppa's ball blows into the pond and George's hat blows into a tree.

Robbies Video auf dem er eine Art Body-Percussion präsentiert, ist sehr beliebt bei den anderen Mitschülern. Doch dann will ein Junge ihn zu einem Wettstreit herausfordern. Robbie lässt sich widerwillig darauf ein.

Min tries to avoid the usual Woori World chaos, but when the family splits up they all get lost in their own fiascos. Jack's mission to find the rare DVD sequel of his favourite movie leads him to the mysterious Collector.
pr.sub: The Real Woori World; The Collector

pr.d: Tori und Beck entschließen sich dazu, den Samstagabend gemeinsam zu verbringen. Doch da es auf keinen Fall ein Date sein kann, verabreden sie sich zu einem Anti-Date. Beide ziehen sich nicht hübsch an und gehen schlecht essen.

Halmoni feels she looks helpless about technology, so she becomes a master hacker and vows to destroy their internet FOREVER! Lily must retrieve a book from the dreaded library: a horrifying maze of unknown terrors.
pr.sub: Halmoni Learns the Internet; The Library

pr.d: Sikowitz will allen Schülern, die für sieben Tage ihr Handy nicht benutzen und nicht ins Internet gehen, eine Eins geben. Doch er hat einen Plan und spielt Jungs und Mädchen gegeneinander aus. Die Mädchen greifen, dann doch zum Handy.
When Alvin gets hurt, Simon agrees to face off against Derek on a survival reality show; Alvin accidentally ruins Brittany's favourite bag and must come up with a way to replace it.
pr.sub: I Will Survive; Alvin's Got a Brand New Bag

pr.d: Tori will unbedingt, dass Beck endlich auf ein Date gehen kann. Doch dadurch wird ihm klar, wie sehr er Jade eigentlich mag.
Alvin helps the mathletes stand up to the school bullies, but in the process they become bullies themselves; Alvin befriends a new student, but Theodore learns something surprising about him.
Robbie verkauft Rex an Francis Thornesmith für 2000 Dollar und verlangt zusätzlich dessen Puppe. Doch schon kurz danach vermisst Robbie seinen alten Rex.
The Thunder family splits up for the night. The boys decide to survive 24 hours in the wilderness, while the girls try to bond over some of Barb's favourite farm activities from her childhood.

Andre wohnt bei Tori zusammen, damit sie an einem Song arbeiten können. Doch sie stellen schnell fest, dass sie nicht die besten Mitbewohner sind. Jade entdeckt, dass ein wenig schmeichelhaftes Bild von ihr im Internet gelandet ist.

Max and Phoebe secretly employ their parents' former sidekick to ease their busy schedule. However, the twins' bickering and inability to share provokes an unexpected response from their new sidekick.

Sikowitz hat sich gedacht, dass es eine gute Idee wäre, wenn alle für einen Tag nur "ja" sagen. Doch leider enden Cat und Robbie dadurch in einer Mülltonne während Trina, Jade und Tori Käsewürfel spielen. Andre, Beck und Sinjin haben auch Vorfälle.
When Ray hears that Piper is going to Junior Anger Management to work on her anger issues, he makes a wager with Henry that he can make her lose her temper before the night ends.

Tori soll für die Quizshow "Brainsqueezers" ein Team zusammenstellen. Ihre Freunde setzen sie deswegen unter Druck. Es dürfen zwar alle teilnehmen, doch das Format entpuppt sich als Horrorshow und alle gehen leer aus.
After Henry uses his new power to compete in a Dodge-A-Leen tournament, Ray, Schwoz and Charlotte go undercover to teach Henry a lesson.

Bei einem großen Sportevent singt Tori die Nationalhymne, wird währenddessen aber unterbrochen und von einem Hund über den Boden geschleift. Danach versucht sie in einer Talkshow, diesen Fehler zu erklären und wiedergutzumachen.
The twins and Marsupilamis' game of golf results in Hope and Punch being caught by Stan. The Twins have Callie for a sleepover and whilst sleepwalking she meets the Marsupilamis.

Mrs. Puff muss SpongeBob zur Aufsichtsperson der Fahrschule ernennen, weil alle anderen schon dran waren, aber SpongeBob nimmt den Job etwas zu ernst, außerdem bereitet SpongeBobs neue Haus-Qualle ihm mit ihren Partys schlechte Laune.

Sandy hat eine Mondrakete, in die sich Patrick und SpongeBob nachts hineinschleichen. Natürlich drücken die Chaoten auf den Startknopf und fliegen los, allerdings landen sie wieder in Bikini Bottom, außerdem hat SpongeBob neue, quietschende Schuhe.

Mr. Krabs' Piratenopa will seinen Enkel besuchen kommen. Allerdings weiß er nicht, dass Mr. Krabs gar kein Pirat mehr ist. Also muss die Krosse Krabbe zum Piratenschiff umgebaut werden. Und: SpongeBob muss Thaddäus aufmuntern.
Dimwitty and Clumsy decide to get rid of the fire truck so that they no longer argue about it. But it's very difficult to put out a fire on foot!
Smurfette and Grouchy compete to determine who is the best. Blossom dreams of travelling to Mars and can rely on her friends for support.
pr.sub: The Battle of the Sitters; Let's Smurf to Mars

pr.d: SpongeBob möchte unbedingt, dass Thaddäus ihn besucht, der könnte sich allerdings kaum etwas Schlimmeres vorstellen. Mit einem Trick lockt SpongeBob ihn rüber. Und: SpongeBob ist gezwungen, runde Hosen zu kaufen, in denen ihn jedoch niemand erkennt.
pr.sub: Besuch von Thaddäus; Quadrathose oder nicht sein

pr.d: Gargamel leaves magic pebbles in the forest to hypnotise the Smurfs.
pr.sub: The Prettiest Pebble in the World

pr.d: Handy has invented a machine that enables him to understand animals. Clumsy and Dimwitty inadvertently open a portal to other worlds.
pr.sub: What the Bear Said; Parallel Worlds

pr.d: SpongeBob und Patrick vertreten Meerjungfraumann und Blaubarsch-Bube, die beide krank sind. Und: Als Thaddäus Lehrer einer Musikschule wird, wollen SpongeBob und Patrick natürlich direkt seine Schüler sein.
Dave sets down a very strict study schedule when Alvin blames him for his poor grades. Theodore must pose as a dog after the chipmunks accidentally shave the fur off a dog Miss Miller is watching.
pr.sub: Alvin Gets Schooled; My Life as a Dog

pr.d: SpongeBob nimmt einen Wurm bei sich auf, der herrenlos ist. Aber Gary hat die lästige Rivalin bald vertrieben. Plankton und Karen streiten und er gibt ihr die Schuld an seinem Unglück. Er will beweisen, dass er auch ohne sie zurechtkommt.

Theo's funky art project becomes a star with its own social media fans, which is great until the page is hacked; Dave writes a hit love song from a poem he found, but since Simon wrote the poem, he panics his secret will come out.

Thaddäus ernennt SpongeBob aus Faulheit zum Chef vom Dienst, was allerdings nur 15 Minuten währt, da dann bereits das Chaos ausgebrochen ist. Und: Sandy, Mr. Krabs und Patrick bitten SpongeBob um Gefallen, die er ihnen nicht abschlagen möchte.

Mr. Krabs stellt Patrick in der Krossen Krabbe ein, um die Kunden zu belustigen. Er spielt den umfallenden Idioten. SpongeBob und Patrick finden einen Spielzeugladen so toll, dass sie sich über Nacht dort einschließen lassen.
pr.sub: Der hutlose Patrick; Spielzeuggeschäft des Grauens

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: The Boss Baby declares war on a popular TV show starring a pygmy goat, a tamandua and their human handler.

pr.t: The Boss Baby: Back in Business
pr.d: Boss Baby throws a cupcake party to combat low company morale, then sends a manager to help Tim handle some family business.

Thaddäus will einen potenziellen neuen Nachbarn, mit dem er sich anfreunden möchte, von SpongeBob und Patrick fernhalten, um ihn nicht zu verschrecken. Thaddäus verliebt sich derweil in eine Kundin und SpongeBob soll ihm helfen, sie zu verführen.
pr.sub: Quallenfischendes Seifenblasenbläserpack; Ein Tintenfisch zum Verlieben

pr.d: Dora, Boots und Diego helfen den Bären-Brüdern dabei, ein tolles Nest für ihre Mama zu bauen! Dora, Boots und Diego helfen einem verirrten Echsen-Baby, zurück zu seinen Eltern zu kommen!
pr.sub: Dora, Diego und die Bären-Brüder / Unterwegs zur Echsen-Insel

pr.d: Scissors meets his perfect romantic match, but she's a mermaid and he can't tell anyone about her. Rock accidentally shrinks Franz and himself while Paper and Scissors host a party to apologise to everyone they've wronged.
Tim und Tommy nehmen sich vor, zusammen einen möglichst großen Mondkürbis heranzuzüchten.
Tim und Tommy helfen in der Eiszeit-Stube aus und stellen sich neuen Aufgaben im Alltag.
When Patrick gets stuck inside a video game, Squidina must guide him out to survive. Patrick does Cecil's chores around the house while hosting a home renovation show in the process.
pr.sub: GAME OVER, PATRICK/THIS OLD COFFEE POT

pr.d: Oma schenkt Tim einen selbstgemachten Hut, doch der erweist sich immer wieder als störend.

1. Geschichte: Leni wird plötzlich schmerzlich bewusst, dass ihre große Schwester bald ausziehen wird, um ans College zu gehen. Deshalb versucht sie mit allen Mitteln ihre Pläne zu durchkreuzen. 2. Geschichte: Clyde und Lincoln eröffnen ihr eigenes Keks-Backgewerbe. So ein eigenes Geschäft hält jedoch mehr Arbeit bereit als sie erwartet haben.
When Plankton takes over the North Pole, SpongeBob, Mr. Krabs and a group of misfits team up to save Christmas.

1. Geschichte: Wenn es um Sport geht, ist Lynn extrem abergläubisch. Damit sorgt sie beim Profi-Eishockeyspiel jedoch für jede Menge Chaos! 2. Geschichte: Die Geschwister wollen sich beim großen Frühjahresputz nicht von ihren alten Spielsachen trennen. Deshalb versuchen sie ihre Eltern davon zu überzeugen, dass sie tatsächlich noch damit spielen.
pr.sub: Auf dünnem Eis; Alles muss raus

pr.d: Der elfjährige Lincoln hat zehn Schwestern. Er zeigt, wie man in solch einem Chaos überlebt. In dieser Folge wird Lincoln zu Unrecht beschuldigt. Er soll angeblich die Toilette verstopft haben. Nun muss er den wahren Schuldigen ausfindig machen.
Die Familie Star fährt zu ihrem Lieblingsort und Bunny begibt sich auf ein mittägliches Abenteuer.
A silver ant needs help getting back home after being swept up by a sandstorm; Sam and Kit head to the swamp to investigate a dinosaur sighting.
pr.sub: The Search for the Silver Ant Hill; The Search for the Swamp Snapper

pr.d: Um die Show aufzulockern, heuert Patrick zwei Geister an, die gemeinsam im Haus spuken und seine Eltern erschrecken. Nach einer Reise durch die Zeit wächst Patrick über sich hinaus und wird zu einer öffentlichen Bedrohung.
pr.sub: Spuk im Star Haus / Wer ist ein grosser Junge?

pr.d: Stan sees Twister eating fish and hides a tracker in one, so he knows Twister's every move. Thanks to the Marsupilamis, Jade looks like an expert at parkour with Mica filming her moves.

Papier und Bleistift erzählen einen Witz und versuchen das Gefühl, damit gut anzukommen, immer wieder zu erleben. Schere engagiert ein Orchester, das ihn begleitet und sein Leben mit Musik vertont, um eine berühmte Freundin zu beeindrucken.
pr.sub: Papier und Bleistift erzählen einen Witz / Scheres Orchester

pr.d: Der frühere Freund Shoot, eine Bambussprosse, kehrt zurück. Doch die drei Freunde wollen nicht mehr mit ihm befreundet sein. Stein hat seinen ersten Arbeitstag bei Franz Roll. Der zeigt sich sehr exzentrisch und äußerst anspruchsvoll.

Zum Schluss folgt eine emotionale Achterbahnfahrt. Franzi kommt gestärkt und sichtbar befreit aus ihrer Einzelsession zurück. Am Abend gibt es Post von zu Hause. Dann ist es so weit: Die Moderatorin läutet das große Finale ein.

Nachdem Frida Kahlo 1925 im Alter von 18 Jahren bei einem Busunfall schwer verletzt worden ist, beginnt sie wie besessen zu malen. Mit dem Pinsel therapiert sie im Bett ihre psychischen und physischen Schmerzen. Gerade auf dem Weg der Besserung lernt sie Diego Rivera kennen und bittet ihn, ehrlich ihr Talent einzuschätzen. Er ist begeistert von ihrem Können - und auch von ihrer Schönheit. Bald schon heiraten sie und werden zu einem der aufregendsten Paare des 20. Jahrhunderts.

Emilie und Marc lassen sich mit ihrem Baby in einem Strandhaus nieder, um einen Neuanfang zu wagen. Eines Tages trifft Emilie Vincent, der beschuldigt wird, seine Frau ermordet zu haben, und beschließt, zu ihrem Job als Anwältin zurückzukehren.

Ein inszeniertes Krimievent wird zur bitteren Realität, als der Hauptdarsteller in der Rolle des Detektivs erstochen aufgefunden wird. Um einen drohenden Medienrummel zu verhindern, muss Janie diesen Fall nun so schnell wie möglich lösen.
Der Redaktionsleiter Flo wird von seinen Kollegen entführt, um einen schönen letzten Tag zu haben.

Der Zufall kommt Alfons zu Hilfe: Weil er sich den Knöchel verstaucht hat, kann er vorerst nicht Fallschirmspringen. Doch er hat nicht mit Sabrina gerechnet: Sie überredet Hildegard, mit ihr zusammen doch noch den Sprung zu wagen. Alfons fällt aus allen Wolken, als Hildegard wieder auf der Erde landet. Er ist so überrumpelt, dass er sich unbedacht zu einer entlarvenden Bemerkung hinreißen lässt.

Goran überredet Natascha, Friedrich zum Geburtstag ein Ständchen zu singen. Die übt daraufhin allein in der Natur und wird unbemerkt von André beobachtet. Zu seinem eigenen Erstaunen bemerkt André, dass er plötzlich Gefühle für Natascha entwickelt. Nachdem er ihr auf anonymem Wege ein Geschenk geschickt hat, überlegt Natascha angetan, wer ihr heimlicher Verehrer sein könnte und staunt nicht schlecht, als sich André als dieser zu erkennen gibt.

Wegen akuter Beschwerden liefert Michael Barbara ins Krankenhaus ein. Er bittet Werner, Barbara dort zu besuchen. Doch der erinnert sich an all ihre bösen Taten in der Vergangenheit. Barbara verlebt eine alptraumhafte Nacht und beschließt, ihrem Leben ein Ende zu setzen. Sie bittet Werner zu sich und es gelingt ihr, ihm wahre Worte der Vergebung zu entlocken. Danach hat Barbara endlich ihren Seelenfrieden gefunden und nimmt beinahe gelassen eine Überdosis Morphium.

Leonard bekommt eine Zusage von der Münchner Flugzeugbaufirma, bei der er sich als Ingenieur beworben hat. Derweil freut sich Coco, als sie erfährt, dass sich Leonard bei Friedrich dafür eingesetzt hat, sie zu seiner Nachfolgerin zu machen. Nur Pauline macht es zu schaffen, dass Leonard bald gehen wird. Als beide gemeinsam nach Holunderbeeren suchen, hat Pauline eine überraschende Bitte an Leonard.
Zu ihrer eigenen Überraschung wird Julia Klug zur Hauptkommissarin befördert und teilt ab sofort das Büro mit ihrem Ex-Chef Johannes Sonntag. Der ist darüber alles andere als begeistert.

Horst Kopke, der Besitzer des bekannten Oldtimer-Autohauses Kopke Original, wird bei dem Einwurf der Tageseinnahmen tödlich von einem fahrenden Auto erfasst. Wurde er Opfer eines Unfalls mit Fahrerflucht oder eines geplanten Mordes?

Lasse begreift, dass er sich in Sachen Nora mehr ins Zeug legen muss. Durch einen Hinweis von Thomas sieht er einen Weg, Nora seine Zuneigung zu zeigen. Nora gibt gegenüber Carla zu, dass Lasse zwar ihr Typ ist, sie aber keine Lust auf komplizierte Männer hat. Umso berührter ist sie, als Lasse eine Überraschung für sie hat. Eliane konzentriert sich nach ihrem Zerwürfnis mit Ben ganz auf ihre Arbeit, lehnt die Einladung zum Konzert von Betty Kayser ab.

Nora und Lasse stehen im Wechselbad ihrer Gefühle. Sie ist irritiert über seine unvermittelte Annäherung, er ist enttäuscht über ihre distanzierte Haltung zu seiner Idee mit der Büchertauschbörse. Aber Lasse gibt nicht auf und will Nora mit einer Vorabausgabe ihres Lieblingsautors überraschen. Die Gefühle brechen sich nun endlich Bahn. Henri hat gerade Edda kennengelernt und ist sofort verzaubert.

Natalie Trautmann wird nach einem Hausbrand in die Sachsenklinik eingeliefert. Sie hat leichte Verbrennungen, ist im sechsten Monat schwanger und klagt über grippale Beschwerden. Als bei Natalie ein Nierenstein festgestellt wird, übernimmt der Urologe Dr. Kaminski die Behandlung. Durch die Vorgeschichte Natalies kommt eine persönliche Note in das Arzt-Patienten-Verhältnis, das Kaminski verunsichert. Gleich beim ersten Gespräch kommt es zu Missverständnissen.

Tobias Stremmer wird mit Lungenhochdruck in die Sachsenklinik eingeliefert. Wegen seiner Abneigung gegen Ausländer gerät Stremmer mit seinem russischen Zimmernachbarn Waldemar Schmidt und dessen Partnerin Olga Schirnow aneinander. Inzwischen hat Dr. Roland Heilmann herausgefunden, dass Martin Stein und Elena Eichhorn seit Wochen ein Paar sind. Roland ist über Martins Geheimniskrämerei erbost.

Das Leben geht weiter, auch ohne die tödlich verunglückten Patriarchen. Die Verwerfungen bei den Leitners und den Hubers halten jedoch an. Die Fehde zwischen den Bergbauern-Clans droht wieder aufzuflammen und auch innerhalb der Familien kriselt es.

Der arrogante Schönheitschirurg Dr. Schubert wird in seiner Praxis von dem Proleten Mike Boll attackiert. Der vorbestrafte Boll ist wütend, weil seine Freundin Doreen über Schmerzen klagt, seit Schubert ihr ein Gesäß-Implantat eingesetzt hat.

Die Frau des Teestubenbesitzers Ismail Yildiz wird von dem Gemüsehändler Ömer Dilek entführt. Das behauptet zumindest eine Augenzeugin. Oder hat sie sich getäuscht? Die Familienmitglieder beider Parteien wollen nicht an ein Verbrechen glauben.

Erika lässt sich unwillig auf den therapeutischen Segelflugkurs ein. Sie hofft, dadurch Merle und Inge endgültig überzeugen zu können, dass sie nicht posttraumatisiert ist. Als in der Gärtnerei plötzlich aus einer exotischen Pflanze eine Bananenspinne kriecht, ist Inge entsetzt. Die sind hochgiftig! Erika unterschätzt die tödliche Gefahr und schreibt Inges Hysterie ihrer Spinnenphobie zu. Doch dann wird Erika von der Spinne gebissen.

Thomas wird auf Simones Hintertreiben in der Presse angefeindet. Volker rät ihm, Simones Streitereien zu ignorieren. Als das Bauamt erst nach Verzögerung die Unterlagen schickt, scheint das Projekt nun deutlich günstiger realisierbar zu sein als unter seinem Vorgänger. Thomas ahnt nicht, dass er direkt in Simones Falle tappt. Währenddessen können Merle und Inge aufatmen, denn Erika schwebt nicht in Lebensgefahr.

Marie erklärt Viktoria, dass Nils der Mann ist, der ihr in Thalheim übel mitgespielt hat. Doch Viktoria stellt Nils trotz Maries eindringlicher Warnung ein. Rosalie spekuliert auf ein schickes Büro. Werner lässt Barbara keine Ruhe.

André hofft, dass ihm das Gericht seine Version vom Tathergang abnimmt. Simon indes wird skeptisch und stellt seinen Vater einmal mehr zur Rede. Ben verzaubert Sylvia. Viktoria hat sich doppelt ins Abseits gestellt. Rosalie hat ein neues Ziel.

Ironische Beiträge und Reportagen beleuchten die Skurrilitäten der politischen Woche. Aber auch andere gesellschaftlich relevante und aktuelle Themen werden auf ihr Humorpotenzial hin überprüft und gegebenenfalls gewürdigt.

Die norddeutsche Kabarettistin, Sängerin und Moderatorin Ina Müller lädt in einer winzigen Kneipe mit Blick auf die Elbe zum Gespräch. Wirtin Rosi kümmert sich währenddessen um das spontan ausgesuchte und doch handverlesene Publikum.

Drei Kindheitsfreundinnen in ihren Vierzigern fahren zur Côte d'Azur im Süden Frankreichs, um eine Ferienwohnung aufzuräumen. Dort wird Cécile, Sonia und Elise schnell bewusst, dass sie immer noch eine sehr attraktive Ausstrahlungskraft auf das andere Geschlecht haben. Sie treffen auf drei jüngere Männer, die starkes Interesse an den Frauen zeigen, die alle langfristig single oder frisch getrennt sind.

Nach Henrys VIII. Tod werden seine Kinder Mary, Elizabeth und Edward zu Figuren in einem gefährlichen Spiel. Sie alle befinden sich im Kampf am englischen Hof um die Herrschaft über das neue England, in dem sie sich nun befinden.

Weihnachten bei Hofe: Ein Maskenspiel entzweit den Protestanten Edward und die Katholikin Mary. Elizabeth steht zwischen ihnen, als Mary verlangt, zu ihr zu ziehen. Lord Protector Somerset versucht, den Frieden zwischen den Geschwistern zu bewahren.

Die Sierra Madre ist Mexikos längstes und höchstes Gebirge im Westen des Landes. Auf den Gipfeln führen traditionelle Indianervölker ein zurückgezogenes Leben und im Schatten von Vulkankratern sorgen Bauern für die Herstellung von Tequila.

Die alten Tempel der Maya befinden sich immer noch in den Regenwäldern der Halbinsel Yucatán. Es haben sich Jaguare, Affen, Vögel und Kaffeebauern dort niedergelassen, wobei unterirdische Flüsse die Oasen miteinander verbinden.

Nordmexiko ist die trockenste Region des Landes mit den zwei Wüsten Sonoran und Chihuahuan. Je mehr man in den Westen reist, desto heißer, trockener und anspruchsvoller wird das Klima. Außerdem sind dort Präriehunde und Aplomadofalken beheimatet.

Bis heute ist London Spionage-Hauptstadt, wo immer wieder Kunstschaffende und Aktivisten ins Fadenkreuz dunkler Mächte geraten. Was für die einen spannende Unterhaltung im Kino ist, ist für die anderen allerdings gefährliche Realität.

In den 70er-Jahren will der junge und machtbesessene Donald Trump endlich aus dem Schatten seines Vaters treten. Mit der Unterstützung des berühmt-berüchtigten Anwalts Roy Cohn gelingt es ihm, ins Immobiliengeschäft in Manhattan einzusteigen und sich durch geschickte Manöver von Cohn als Immobilienmagnat an die Spitze zu setzen. Cohn ist es auch, der Trump schließlich beibringt, wie man durch Täuschung, Einschüchterung und Medienmanipulation zu Reichtum und Macht gelangt.

Radio X's guru of new music brings you the essential tracks you need to hear, with sessions, interviews and more.
Justice is served. Disgraced media mogul, Harvey Weinstein, was sentenced to 23 years in prison for sexual criminal acts. Witness the rise and fall of one of Hollywood's most powerful men.

Reynhard Sinaga is the UK's most prolific rapist. Meeting men outside Manchester nightclubs, he drugged, sexually assaulted and filmed his depraved acts with at least 200 young men for the past 12 years. Featuring interviews with those affected.
In Norfolk, an otherwise unassuming summer evening is shaken by an armed robbery. A vehicle is stolen, and innocent people are shot.

Detective Inspector Burgess of Norwich CID has a problem as the number of home burglaries has rocketed. Looking at the evidence, officers suspect that one man is potentially responsible for a large part of the spike in residential crime.
After a raid on a cannabis factory, nine people are arrested, and it is up to the team to get to the bottom of which role each suspect played.
The team in Norwich gather evidence about a single-punch attack that has left a man seriously injured, and there are no willing witnesses.
Unprecedented access reveals the critical role of digital forensics in modern murder investigations.

pr.t: Wayne Couzens: Killer in Plain Sight
pr.d: Using interviews with expert witnesses, detectives and members of law enforcement, it reveals the true story of Wayne Couzens, asks how he was able to hide from scrutiny for so long, and considers the larger problem of misogyny in the police force.
Two ice-cream shop employees are killed in what appears to be a robbery gone wrong. Four years later, the perpetrator of this vicious double homicide is still at large.
Donna Fowler's disappearance isn't her first, but it's her last. Years later, Stacy Belcher vanishes too. Two families face the horror of a long-time monster.
When Marlene Major disappears in 1980, her family suspects she ran off to escape her abusive husband. Her daughter is determined to learn the truth and seek justice for her mother.
Marilyn Kananen has vanished, and her children are afraid that their abusive father has returned.
Two years after a 13-year-old girl was taken from her home, her skull is found.
Justice is served. Disgraced media mogul, Harvey Weinstein, was sentenced to 23 years in prison for sexual criminal acts. Witness the rise and fall of one of Hollywood's most powerful men.

Peter Britton Tobin was a Scottish convicted serial killer and sex offender who served a whole life order at HM Prison Edinburgh for three murders committed between 1991 and 2006. Delve into the psychology of Peter to try and understand what turned him into such a cruel rapist and murderer.
Dennis Andrew Nilsen was a Scottish serial killer and necrophiliac who murdered at least 12 young men and boys in London between 1978 and 1983.
This is the chilling but little-known story of Trevor Hardy, the serial killer known as the 'Beast of Manchester' who murdered three teenage girls between December 1974 and March 1976.
Charting a brutal real life tale of kidnapping, enslavement and murder.
A couple of Kentucky blue bloods team up to form a front for their drug smuggling business. As the operation grows, so too does the paranoia and betrayal.
NFL's Rae Carruth is tried for ordering a hit on his girlfriend. Armed with her account and the testimonies of the shooter and driver, prosecutors push for the ultimate punishment.
Turn back the clock and uncover the truth behind the OJ Simpson trial.
A Miami river washes up a torso, leaving investigators baffled about where the remaining body parts are, or whether the person was male or female.
In New Mexico, police are called when 18-year-old Carly Martinez disappears from a local skating rink after a date with a friend.
When a car crashed down an embankment, rescue workers scrambled to save a couple trapped inside, but what followed was an unexpected twist.
A field becomes a graveyard in Ohio when a woman's body is discovered, but solving her murder means turning to a rare technique of fingerprinting.
When firefighters are called to a home in the middle of the night, they discover a fire raging out of control and a mystery woman's charred body.

pr.t: The Gentle Bear Man of Emo
pr.d: Michael finds that the bonds he forges with the bears and other wild animals that live on his property in Emo, Ontario, helped heal his soul after a tragedy. His relationship with the animals put him on a path to love and redemption.

Summer in Yellowstone is a time of warmth and light; more than any other season, it brings an abundance of life to the park, from flowering plants and insects to hungry grizzly bears, curious coyotes and herds of elk.

Fall is a season of change in Yellowstone; the park bursts with vivid colours; some of its residents take advantage of the last few remaining lazy days of summer, while others prepare for the snowy season ahead, including finding a mate.
Winter is by far the longest season of Yellowstone as well as its cruellest. Only the toughest and cleverest survive the cold, starvation and competition.
The reef life, and the birds, lizards and reptiles that cope with the lava rock islands of the Galápagos, make this remote series of islands a unique natural habitat.
pr.sub: In the Grip of the Ocean

pr.d: The Galápagos Islands are home to animals that have made adaptations, including penguins, iguanas, tortoises, cormorants and - possibly the oddest - the vampire finch.

High in the mountains, over 10,000 feet up, an unlikely champion stands: the whitebark pine. This resilient tree sustains life, providing food and shelter for animals like the grizzly bear, red squirrels and more.
Following the three key predators of the Yellowstone ecosystem: the wolf, red fox and coyote.
The headwaters of seven major rivers run from the Continental Divide across the ecosystem and flow into the western United States; the waters carve the landscape, creating natural boundaries.
The Yellowstone region is one of the planet's largest, nearly intact temperate zone ecosystems.

Our film journey begins in Alaska's west. We are hoping to find glacier bears in the glacial regions of the Katmai National Park on the Douglas River. At the end of July, brown bears have now arrived to fish for salmon. In the surrounding forests, grizzlies look for berries and fresh, green twigs. The Katmai is Alaska's most volcanic area, and with 15 active volcanoes it is a veritable powder keg, surrounded by glaciers. In the Hook glacier region moose and lynx accompany us.

pr.t: In the Feeding Grounds of the Humpback Whales
pr.d: In the warm Pacific just off the coast of Maui, a humpback whale mother has paired and given birth to her baby. She takes her baby on a 5500-kilometer-long journey to the grazing grounds off Alaska.

In southern Alaska, bald eagles flock by the thousands in autumn for the last salmon migration of the year and to prepare their young for the harsh winter. In the Dolomites, a look at a couple of golden eagles and their offspring.

pr.t: In the Land of the Moose
pr.d: At the end of the summer, a moose finds herself alone in the forest. She has just lost her calf, probably to a bear. Now she must find a mate. Once pregnant again, she will endure months of bone-chilling winter until she delivers in the spring.
Hidden ecosystems and changing coastlines reveal nature's resilience around New York Harbor.
Jamaica Bay's wildlife and restored marshes reflect resilience in a changing coastal world.
Historic waterways and diverse habitats reveal nature's resilience along the East Coast.

Winter slowly releases its cold grasp on Yellowstone, but spring is slow to arrive. The sun melts the snow and ice, waking the park and its residents from a deep winter slumber. With the thaw comes water, and with water comes an abundance of food.

The warmth of spring brings new life and energy to Yellowstone. Bears come out of hiding. Babies of all shapes and sizes explore their incredible new world. Every resident is eager to enjoy this magical time full of promise.
Yellowstone's seasonal changes drive movement, choice, habit and evolution; key moments are revisited to see how the seasons and landscape shape the actions of the park's residents.

pr.t: Golden Eagles: Witnesses to a Changing West
pr.d: Eagles in Wyoming face climate change, sprawl, lead, energy threats; rehab and tribal ties aid them.
The alpha female of the Hayden Valley Pack is followed in her life as a puppy until her death.
The white daughter soon finds a mate, who dispersed from the Mollies Pack with two other males. The new pack, now called the Canyon Pack, claims Hayden Valley as their territory.
Follows two families of river otters in Yellowstone and how they join together to face challenges.

Yellowstone National Park is home to one of nature's most sophisticated minds: the Common Raven. We follow a mated pair in the Lamar River Valley, revealing their astonishing intelligence and complex survival tactics in the harsh wilderness.
After 32 years as a border patrol agent, Ben Clemens is forced to work for the very people he spent his career trying to keep out of America, which ends up challenging his ideology and his loyalties.
Documents some of the most astonishing and unexpected behaviours of grizzly bears as they live out their difficult lives in the terrain of Yellowstone National Park in the United States.
Chile's coast runs 2,600 miles and boasts extraordinary diversity and an abundance of wildlife, from pumas to blue whales. In the Patagonian steppes a cougar mother plays tenderly with her cubs.

Die Milliardärstochter Chloe Ford wird entführt und die Agenten haben den Täter schnell ermittelt: Mike Helton, ein ehemaliger Soldat. Über das GPS seines Wagens spüren sie Helton in einem leerstehenden Landhaus einer seiner Arbeitgeber auf.

Bei einer Demonstration wird die ehemalige Anwältin Nicole Mitchell erschossen. Als sich eine Verbindung zu einem weiteren Mord wenige Stunden zuvor an dem Gangboss Ramirez herstellen lässt, findet sich auf den ersten Blick keine Verbindung.

Die BAU versucht, einen Verdächtigen für einen rituellen Mord ausfindig zu machen. Der Mörder versetzt Tallahassee in Angst und Schrecken. Dabei tötet er die Menschen unter sehr ähnlichen Umständen. Das Team muss den Psychopathen dringend stoppen.

Die BAU untersucht eine gruselige Geistergeschichte über den "Großen Mann". Dann gehen zwei Menschen im Wald verloren. Eine dritte Person taucht am nächsten Tag auf mysteriöse Weise auf, ohne erklären zu können, was passiert ist.

Die BAU reist an die Ostküste, um vier schrecklichen Morden auf den Grund zu gehen. Die Ermittler finden heraus, dass die Morde in Verbindung mit Luke Alvez stehen. Dieser war vor einigen Jahren hinter einem Killer aus Mexiko her.

Tarek und Christina erhalten einen Anruf von ihrem guten Freund Carlos, der sein Haus verkaufen möchte. Die beiden wissen natürlich, wie man den Verkaufspreis durch ein paar Arbeiten erhöhen kann, und helfen Carlos bei seinem Projekt.

pr.t: No Demo Reno - Umbau ohne Abriss
pr.d: Jenn spart eine Menge Geld, indem sie sich entscheidet, die Küchenschränke von Brittany und Jack selbst zu streichen. Doch sie stellt bald fest, dass es nicht so einfach ist, mit einer Farbe zu arbeiten, die sie nicht ausgewählt hat.

Christina widmet sich der Transformation eines chaotischen Hauses, dessen unpraktische Raumaufteilung dem Paar längst zur Last geworden ist. Um das Potenzial des Hauses freizulegen, reißt sie nahezu alle Wände ein und beginnt von Grund auf neu.

Ein Paar, das vor kurzem ein Haus gekauft hat, benötigt Unterstützung bei der Umgestaltung in ein Zuhause für sich und seine drei Kinder. Christina plant eine Erweiterung ihres Hauptwohnraums, aber Probleme könnten die Renovierung verzögern.

Eigentlich wollte Chandler mit Monica in ein romantisches Hotel nach Vermont fahren, doch die hat leider keine Zeit. Deshalb stellt sich kurzfristig Ross als Mitreisender zur Verfügung und freut sich schon auf ein paar lustige Stunden mit seinem Kumpel. Rachel begleitet unterdessen Joey zum Set und sieht ihm bei einer Liebesszene zu. Als er mit ihr daheim noch einmal seinen Text durchgeht, ist es um Rachel geschehen - sie träumt plötzlich davon, ihn zu küssen!

Joey besorgt für seine Freunde Theaterkarten, damit er mit seinem Serienteam ungestört eine Party auf dem Dach feiern kann. Auf Umwegen erfährt Rachel davon und erzählt es natürlich den anderen, sodass sich alle auf der Party einfinden und sich dort blendend amüsieren. Nur Chandler wurde von seinen Freunden vergessen und sitzt nun im Theater in einem Ein-Personen-Stück, das von einer Frau handelt, die keiner mag. Und Chandler kann ihr wahrlich nachfühlen.

Eigentlich steht die attraktive Professorin Charlie auf Paläontologen. Umso verwunderter ist Ross, als er erfährt, dass sie sich ausgerechnet mit Joey verabredet hat. Obwohl er selbst gerne ein Rendezvous mit Charlie gehabt hätte, hilft Ross seinem Freund, intelligent zu wirken. In der Zwischenzeit stellen Chandler und Monica erschrocken fest, dass ihr sowieso schon unangenehmer Besuch in der Fruchtbarkeitsklinik sogar noch schrecklicher wird als gedacht.

Chandler bringt seinen Kollegen Zack mit nach Hause, um ihn Monica als Samenspender vorzustellen - doch Monica will nur von Chandler schwanger werden. Da dies nicht möglich ist, entscheiden sie sich für eine Adoption. Indessen belauscht Charlie ein Gespräch zwischen Phoebe und Rachel, in dem es darum geht, dass Rachel es auf Joey abgesehen hat. Phoebe rät ihr, Charlie nicht in die Quere zu kommen.

Jackson und April wollen ihre Affäre nicht beenden. Christina schläft mit ihrem Boss aus reiner Berechnung. Sie findet heraus, dass ein Kollege wegen seines Alters gefeuert werden soll. Catherine ist in der Stadt und flirtet heftig mit Richard.

Meredith rettet eine verunglückte Frau auf dem Weg zur Arbeit. Sie hat außerdem Probleme damit, ihren Job und ihre Familie unter einen Hut zu bringen. Denn Zola hat Fieber. Derweil findet Cristina in ihrem Mentor Dr. Thomas ein Idol.

Lorelai ist noch immer verärgert über Rory und Dean, die eine ganze Nacht lang nicht nach Hause gekommen waren. Auch mit Emily gibt es gewaltigen Streit. Lorelai ist nicht einmal beim gemeinsamen Weihnachtsessen erwünscht. Sie sucht Gesellschaft bei Luke, als sie die Nachricht erreicht, dass ihr Vater zusammengebrochen ist.

Gerade als Rory beginnt, die Beziehung ihrer Mutter mit ihrem Lehrer Max zu akzeptieren, macht Lorelai einen Rückzieher. Auf dem Elternabend will sie mit Max Schluss machen. Die Aussprache endet in einem Kuss, der von Paris beobachtet wird. Kurz danach weiß die ganze Schule Bescheid. Max muss um seinen Job fürchten.

Rory verhilft Lane zu einer Verabredung mit ihrem Schwarm Todd. Heimlich trifft sie sich mit dem Jungen. Alles scheint gut zu gehen. Nach einem Kinobesuch wird Lane jedoch von ihrer Mutter erwischt und mit Hausarrest bestraft. Lorelai lässt sich zu einem Doppeldate mit Sookie, dem Gemüsehändler Jackson und dessen langweiligen Cousin überreden. Luke ist so eifersüchtig, dass er sich endlich ein Herz fasst und Lorelai bittet, mit ihm auszugehen.

Auf einem Wohltätigkeitsbasar kauft Lorelai eine alte Jacke. Doch als sie diese Luke vorführen will, gerät er in Rage, denn die Jacke gehörte einst seiner großen Liebe Rachel. Lorelai versucht sogleich, mehr über die mysteriöse Ex-Freundin herauszufinden. Sookie hat indes Karten für ein Konzert der Bangles besorgt. Kurzerhand schenkt Lorelai Rory die Karten, damit diese ihre Mitschülerinnen aus Chilton einladen kann, um sich mit ihnen anzufreunden.

Während der rechtlichen Auseinandersetzung mit der Fluglinie müssen sich die Absturzüberlebenden den Gegebenheiten ihrer Verletzungen stellen. Derweil wendet Bailey Tricks an, um Arizona dazu zu bringen, an einem Fall mitzuarbeiten.

Inmitten des bevorstehenden Gerichtsverfahrens versuchen Cristina und Owen herauszufinden, wo ihre Beziehung steht. Bailey streitet sich mit Ben über die Hochzeitspläne, und Callie bittet Jackson, ihr dabei zu helfen, Dereks Hand zu retten.

Im ersten Teil des Staffelfinals spitzt sich die Lage zwischen Felicia und Paul dramatisch zu, während Susan die Polizei überzeugen muss, Paul nicht vergiftet zu haben. Derweil verbringen Lynette und Tom ein gemeinsames Wochenende, um ihre Ehe wieder in den Griff zu bekommen.

Susan, Gaby, Bree, Lynette und Carlos müssen schnell die Leiche von Gabys Stiefvater entsorgen, der von Carlos getötet wurde, als er seine Frau beschützen wollte. Schnell überkommt den Beteiligten an der Tat jedoch das schlechte Gewissen. Susan zieht sich von ihren Freunden und ihrer Familie zurück, während Gaby versucht, mit Carlos zu sprechen.
pr.sub: Geheimnisse, die ich nie erfahren will

pr.d: Während Bree verzweifelt versucht herauszufinden, wer der Verfasser des ominösen Briefes ist, sucht Susan nach jeder möglichen Form der Bestrafung, um mit ihren Schuldgefühlen zurechtzukommen. Derweil setzt Gaby alle Hebel in Bewegung, damit sich Carlos besser fühlt und Lynette und Tom geraten wegen ihres Sohnes Parker aneinander.

Während Bree und Gaby versuchen herauszufinden, ob Chuck irgendetwas von ihrem Geheimnis ahnt, wendet sich Lee an Renee, da dieser ein Problem mit seiner Adoptivtochter Jenny hat. Derweil wird Mikes Misstrauen geweckt, als er sieht, wie Susan und Carlos ungewohnt viel Zeit miteinander verbringen und Lynette erhält Besuch von ihrer Schwester Lydia, die ihren neuen Verlobten mitbringt.

pr.t: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
pr.d: Knockabout comedy set in the sexist world of 1970s newscasting. Ron Burgundy, San Diego's top-rated anchorman, reigns supreme in the all-male world of television news, until the arrival of an ambitious female reporter upsets the status quo. When she steps in to present the programme in Ron's absence, an uncivil war breaks out in the newsroom.
A news reporter tries to stay classy when he and his team take New York and the nation's first 24-hour global cable news network by storm.
Wrongfully accused and on the run, a top MI6 agent joins forces with his dim-witted brother to save the world from a sinister plot.

An overstressed husband becomes obsessed with finding out the secret of his mysterious new neighbours. Concocting a series of increasingly outlandish schemes to discover the truth about the weird sounds he hears coming from the basement next door, the man settles on the theory that the family are a front for a cannibalistic cult.
Needing a male heir to the throne, Prince Akeem returns to Queens, N.Y., to find his long-lost son and bring him back to Zamunda.

When cops Schmidt and Jenko join the secret Jump Street unit, they use their youthful appearances to go undercover as high-school students, trading in their guns and badges for backpacks, and setting out to shut down a dangerous drug ring.
Two police officers begin to question their partnership after each infiltrates different cliques while undercover at a local college.
Needing a male heir to the throne, Prince Akeem returns to Queens, N.Y., to find his long-lost son and bring him back to Zamunda.

Two friends create and build a successful beauty company from the ground up, but a buyout offer begins to test their friendship. Suddenly, all the differences that made them a perfect match put them at war, both professionally and personally.

A pair of idiotic friends set off on a madcap journey to return a briefcase to its owner. However, they are blissfully unaware that the case contains a large amount of ransom money for the owner's kidnapped husband. Their trip is soon fraught with disaster, especially when the kidnappers begin to pursue them across the country with the aim of grabbing the cash.

pr.t: Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd
pr.d: In the 80s, Harry meets Lloyd in high school, where they cross paths with a mean principal and a bunch of other outcasts, much like themselves. They are put in a `special needs' class, and attempt to get out.

All is revealed in the explosive conclusion. Unprecedented interviews with O.J.'s inner circle expose a drug-smuggling ally who escaped prison shortly before the murders. Jaw-dropping information unveils the identity of O.J.'s alleged co-conspirator.
The chilling crimes of serial killer Colin Pitchfork, who took the lives of two girls in Leicestershire and became the first person to be convicted of rape and murder using DNA profiling.
A wealthy couple and their business partner are brutally murdered in their home in the hills of Las Cruces, New Mexico, and after a year of dead ends, police find the smoking gun.
Police in West Wales respond to a huge fight that unfolds outside a nightclub and target the house of a suspected drug dealer.
The team battle to keep the peace on the streets when two warring gangs come to blows.
An extremely intoxicated woman puts herself and others in danger when she drives her vehicle several metres off the road. A motorcyclist overtaking a car ends up in pain.
A man has an over-the-top reaction when he gets pulled over by the police, and the Yarra Range Highway Patrol sets up a secret sting.
The motorway gets shut down to rescue horses from a crashed horse-float. Plus, one guy was supposed to be the sober driver, but he did not stay that way.
A passenger hopes for a smash hit for her rap, GPS distraction causes a crash, and police discover fake rego labels made with sticky tape.
A traffic cop gets more than he bargained for when he pulls over a man for not wearing a seat belt.
When two sisters from Bolivia get checked after landing at Dublin Airport, Ray Flannery learns that one has come to Ireland to study, but the other sibling is showing as suspicious.
A drug dealer is trapped in an elaborate sting by the elite undercover crime squad, and there is a desperate scramble in the hunt for a gang that could be armed.
In Greater Manchester, PC Greaves and his German shepherd Riley foil some teenage thieves in the process of robbing a discount store, and the duo later check out a break-in at a railway yard.
From catastrophic chain reactions to wild UK police chases, tow job disasters and modded vehicle madness! We've got it all, all caught on camera.
In May 2023, Georgina Dowey was found murdered in Neath. Her childhood sweetheart was arrested after CCTV linked him to disposing evidence.
During a drunken argument, violent alcoholic Philip Middleton murdered his parents with a granite block in a heartless attack at their family home in Wootton Bassett, Wiltshire.
The story of 'The I-95 Killer', Gary Ray Bowles, who became one of the FBI's most wanted fugitives for brutally murdering six men in 1994 before being put on death row and executed in 2019.
When the body of teenager Connor Lyons is found in the River Hull, police investigators begin to have suspicions that his death might be connected to the sale of a bike on social media.
After a night out in Northampton in 2016, 20-year-old India Chipcase was lured to her death by a man who had been overheard reassuring her that he would get her back home safely.
The killer of a woman remained at large for more than 30 years until a team of forensic investigators finally tracked the murderer down using a tiny clue found at the scene of the crime.
When a woman is found dead in a hotel, police investigators realise that an apparent suicide is not what it seems to be, leading to an extensive search for a killer that crosses borders.

A fugitive from the United States murders one British police officer and tries to kill two more when he is stopped in a stolen BMW, sparking a nationwide search that culminates in armed police arresting him.
In Texas, paediatric nurse Genene Jones transformed into a serial killer, fatally injecting upwards of 60 infants and children with drugs from the 1970s until her arrest in 1982.
A girl is found murdered in the river near her home. For years, the community live in fear of a killer among them until a boy helps police crack the case.

Shedding light on shocking crimes that have taken place in small towns and villages across Britain, from chilling execution murders by complete strangers to crimes of passion in the most unexpected locations.
When a Colorado grandfather vanishes, conflicting family stories lead police to uncover a dark betrayal beneath the concrete floor of his own basement.

Roxy Hart is sent to prison for shooting her lying lover. In prison, she meets tabloid darling and headline singer, Velma Kelly, who is also in for a double murder. With the help of a slick Chicago lawyer, she learns to play the media game and vies for the valuable press attention that will get her out of jail.

Escaping postwar Europe, a visionary architect comes to America to rebuild his life, his career, and his marriage. On his own in a strange new country, he settles in Pennsylvania, where a wealthy and prominent industrialist recognises his talent.

An opera star arrives at a performers' retirement home amidst fraught preparations for a fundraising concert. Her presence adds to the tension, but it also offers an opportunity to reunite a successful quartet.
When ex-German international and camp commandant Van Steiner suggests a match between the POWs and the Germans, it swiftly escalates into a propaganda exercise.

Moving tale about an 11-year-old tomboy growing up in the 1970s. The girl harbours the secret belief that she is responsible for her mother's death in childbirth, and is troubled by her father's new relationship with a beautician at his funeral parlour. However, the girl finds a way through her emotional difficulties with the help of her best friend.
After an ambitious manager gives them a shot at stardom, three singers learn that fame can carry a high personal cost.
A teenage girl wants revenge on the man who killed her father, but she needs help from legendary one-eyed marshal "Rooster" Cogburn, and a Texas Ranger.

An opera star arrives at a performers' retirement home amidst fraught preparations for a fundraising concert. Her presence adds to the tension, but it also offers an opportunity to reunite a successful quartet.
A grieving Jacqueline Kennedy examines her husband's legacy as America mourns his death.
In the summer of 1930, the Crawleys grapple with the threat of social disgrace when Mary finds herself at the centre of a public scandal and the family face financial trouble.
When her father is murdered, 14-year-old girl Mattie Ross hires grizzled US Marshal Rooster Cogburn to track down the killer into hostile Indian territory. Based on Charles Portis' novel.

In the 1970s, a 15-year-old boy gets the chance to live out his dream of touring with a band as a rock journalist. The son of a loving but strict single parent, the boy rebels against her distrust of rock music and the surrounding drug culture by writing album reviews which attract sponsorship from a big magazine to tour with a band. Ignoring all advice, he befriends band members and groupies alike.

A pregnant woman was deserted by her partner. When she goes into labour, a friendly taxi driver rushes her to hospital and the pair become firm friends. He slowly falls in love with her and her baby, but she's still looking for the perfect partner, not realising he's right under her nose. However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.
A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.

In the third of the 'Look Who's Talking' comedies, two dogs enter the Umbriacco household - and take an immediate dislike to each other. When Molly loses her job, husband James is forced to take on a demanding role as private airline pilot. The children miss him, so he buys a dog to cheer them up. However, when James's glamorous boss asks his family to look after her poodle, sparks fly between the dogs.
Discover some of the very best Sky Originals to watch with the whole family, from 'Monster Family' to 'The Amazing Maurice'.

pr.t: The SpongeBob Movie: Sponge Out of Water
pr.d: SpongeBob goes on a quest to discover a stolen recipe that takes him to our world, where he tangles with a pirate.
Mario, Luigi and Princess Peach embark on an adventure across the galaxy.

Unknown to humans, all-out war between cats and dogs has raged since the beginning of time. Now the cats face defeat if scientist Professor Brody can perfect a formula that will make all humans non-allergic to dogs. The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.

pr.t: Cats & Dogs: The Revenge of Kitty Galore
pr.d: The canine and feline species join forces to thwart the evil plans of a rogue cat who dreams of global domination.

A life-saving surgery fuses together a police officer and his faithful police dog -- and Dog Man is born. Learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree.

pr.t: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs
pr.d: Inventor Flint Lockwood dreams of discovering an idea that will change people's lives forever, and after several misguided attempts he may just have done it. Flint has invented a machine that can turn water into delicious food, and, when his first demonstration accidentally sends the machine shooting into the clouds, cheeseburgers begin raining down from the sky.
Mario, Luigi and Princess Peach embark on an adventure across the galaxy.

pr.t: Cloudy With a Chance of Meatballs 2
pr.d: Discovering that his most famous machine is now creating animal/vegetable hybrids, inventor Flint Lockwood and his friends venture forth to save the world from tacodiles, shrimpanzees and other creatures.

Sonic tries to navigate the complexities of life on Earth with his newfound best friend, a human named Tom Wachowski. They must soon join forces to prevent the evil Dr Robotnik from capturing Sonic and using his powers for world domination.

Demonised as the Wicked Witch of the West, Elphaba lives in exile, while Glinda resides at the palace in Emerald City. As an angry mob rises against the Wicked Witch, she'll need to reunite with Glinda to transform herself, and all of Oz, for good.

Perennial family favourite about Dorothy, a young girl from the American Midwest, who is swept by a cyclone to a magical kingdom over the rainbow. There she meets a scarecrow, a tin man and a cowardly lion, who join her on a quest to find the all-powerful Wizard of Oz, the only man who can help her get back to Kansas. However, the Wicked Witch of the West has other plans for Dorothy and her new friends.
With Wednesday and Pugsley off to summer camp, a greedy nanny plots to marry and murder wealthy Uncle Fester.
A thirtysomething slacker attempts to inject some stability into his life by adopting an impressionable five-year-old.

A tough cop is forced to go undercover as a kindergarten teacher. In his new role, he must track down a mother and son who are the only witnesses against a drug-dealing criminal, who is also their husband and father. The cop uses his brutal methods to negotiate the mundane problems of child control.

Concocting a series of increasingly outlandish schemes to discover the truth about the weird sounds he hears coming from the basement next door, the man settles on the theory that the family are a front for a cannibalistic cult.

Bart, a black railroad worker is appointed sheriff of a town marked for destruction by Hedley Lamarr, a scheming politician. As Lamarr tries to drive out the town's residents, Bart decides to stand in his way.

pr.t: See No Evil, Hear No Evil
pr.d: Lighthearted adventures of a pair of news vendors in New York - one deaf, one blind - who go on the run when they are blamed for the murder of a customer. Each has seen - or heard - just a whiff of a clue, and a frantic chase ensues as the duo struggle to clear their names.
A teen suffers the pain of adolescence as she longs for Mr Right while fending off the advances of the class clown.

An out-of-work actor dresses in drag for an audition, only to land the female lead in a TV soap. When he becomes the most popular character on the show, he feels compelled to carry the persona into his everyday life. While bringing him phenomenal success as an `actress', life as a woman also has its problems - especially when he falls for an actress with whom he works.

When one-time rock hopeful Robbie is jilted at the altar, he vents his bitterness in song, even when singing at other people's weddings. Only true love can redeem the broken-hearted songster but fortunately, he's about to meet a woman who will spin him right round (like a record).

An unconventional sleuth attempts to find a football team's stolen mascot dolphin. The Miami 🏈 [NFL] Dolphins are aghast when their beloved Snowflake is abducted one week before the all-important Super Bowl, so they call in Ace Ventura, a private eye who uses unorthodox methods to retrieve missing animals.

Legendary pet detective Ace Ventura returns for another adventure when he's coerced out of retirement while on a soul-searching retreat in the Himalayas. He must now retrieve an endangered white bat from a village located in Africa. The sacred animal was offered up as a wedding dowry from the Wachootoo prince to the Wachati princess, and, if Ace can't track down the culprit behind the kidnapping in time, civil war will break out between the two rival tribes.

A shy student becomes a crime fighter after a bite from a mutant spider, during a school outing, gives him extraordinary powers. As he comes to terms with his new-found abilities, he is also forced to contend with a maniac villain known as the Green Goblin.

When a failed nuclear fusion experiment results in an explosion that kills his wife, Dr. Otto Octavius is transformed into Dr. Octopus, a cyborg with deadly metal tentacles. Doc Ock blames Spider-Man for the accident and seeks revenge. Meanwhile, Spidey's alter ego, Peter Parker, faces fading powers and self-doubt. Complicating matters are his best friend's hatred for Spider-Man and his true love's sudden engagement to another man.

The phantom-fighters return to the streets of New York when they come to the aid of a woman who fears that her baby is the target of ghostly forces. Four years after Dr Peter Venkman broke up with Dana Barrett, she appeals for help to save her son when an arch-demon trapped in an oil painting wants to take over his body. The old team reunite and trace the source of the trouble to a sinister underground river of slime.

It's been 40 years since Laurie Strode survived a vicious attack from crazed killer Michael Myers on Halloween night. She now faces a terrifying showdown when the masked madman returns to Haddonfield, Illinois, but this time, Laurie's ready for him.

The world is struck by inexplicable phenomena - Rome's Colosseum explodes, London's pigeons go berserk - until it becomes apparent that the planet's core has stopped moving, causing electro-magnetic mayhem. The only hope lies in a crack team of scientists burrowing to the core and re-starting earth's engine, but is the disaster natural or is there a more sinister explanation?
A ragtag band of humans bands together in the year 2025 to fight legions of monstrous creatures rising from the sea.

Dr Louis Creed and his wife, Rachel, relocate from Boston to rural Maine with their two young children. The couple soon discover a mysterious burial ground hidden deep in the woods near their new home. When tragedy strikes, Louis turns to his neighbour Jud Crandall, setting off a perilous chain reaction that unleashes an unspeakable evil with horrific consequences.
Fang-in-cheek tale about a single-parent family who move to the coastal town of Santa Clara where the local juvenile delinquents are actually a pack of vampires.

Outlaw Riddick, on the request of the peacemakers, lands on planet New Mecca and comes face to face with the army of Necromongers who are threatening all planets in their path. Their leader, Lord Marshal, wishes to convert all humans to his beliefs, or kill them.
Left stranded after an attack in space, Kirk, Spock and the rest of the crew must battle a deadly alien race while trying to find a way off their hostile planet.
A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact.

Officer K, a new Blade Runner for the Los Angeles Police Department, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos. His discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard, a former Blade Runner who's been missing for 30 years.

A party of high school students settle in a woodland cabin for the weekend. When they find and read a copy of 'The Book of the Dead', a tome that raises not just demons outside the walls but within, they become demonically possessed with murderous desires.
A washed-up Hollywood action hero takes a role in a small English village's quirky Christmas pantomime, where he finds unexpected inspiration through the show's straight-talking dance instructor.

Fastidious businessman Neal Page and slobbish shower-curtain salesman Del Griffith are the reluctant odd couple trying to get home from New York to Chicago to be with their families at Thanksgiving. Their thwarted travel plans keep throwing them together.
A tormented father makes vengeance his life's mission after his son is caught in a gang's crossfire and dies on Christmas Eve.

After starting to feel like Santa does not appreciate her, Mrs Claus takes her husband's sleigh and reindeer to New York, only to be grounded when one of them hurts its leg and needs a week's rest. While waiting, Mrs Claus works as a supervisor in a toy factory, where she helps to improve child labour in 1910 Manhattan.
A girl presents a department-store Santa with an odd request: reunite her divorced parents before her mother remarries.

At Christmas, rich loser Drew takes a nostalgic trip out to his old family house. Drew doesn't have anywhere to go for the holidays, so he persuades the family now living in the house to put him up, for a handsome fee, of course.

An anxious teacher starts a new job at an under-achieving school and quickly finds himself struggling to cope with a wild classroom assistant, a group of under-performing kids and his own very pregnant wife.
The pupils at St Bernadette's primary school are on their best behaviour for the arrival of strict new teacher Mr Shepherd. But when he loses his memory, it's up to the kids to save the day.
